1: # =============================================================================
2: # aurora_udp_bridge.xdc — project_8 Aurora-UDP 数据级桥
3: # 引脚来源：官方 39 例程（GE1 RGMII）+ IBERT/Aurora 定版（GT refclk/控制脚）
4: # =============================================================================
5: 
6: ## ---- bitstream config（官方 39/53）----
7: set_property CFGBVS VCCO [current_design]
8: set_property CONFIG_VOLTAGE 3.3 [current_design]
9: set_property CONFIG_MODE SPIx4 [current_design]
10: set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.CONFIGRATE 50 [current_design]
11: set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.SPI_BUSWIDTH 4 [current_design]
12: set_property BITSTREAM.CONFIG.UNUSEDPIN PULLNONE [current_design]
13: set_property BITSTREAM.GENERAL.COMPRESS TRUE [current_design]
14: 
15: ## ---- clocks ----
16: # RGMII 接收时钟 125M（PHY 提供）
17: create_clock -period 8.000  -name eth_rxc   [get_ports eth_rxc]
18: # GT 参考时钟 156.25M（MGTREFCLK1_226 = T6/T5，IBERT 实测定版）
19: create_clock -period 6.400  -name gt_refclk [get_ports gt_refclk_p]
20: # Aurora init clock 100M 差分（AK17/AK16，独立于恢复时钟）
21: create_clock -period 10.000 -name init_clk  [get_ports init_clk_p]
22: 
23: ## ---- GT refclk: MGTREFCLK1_226 (T6/T5) 156.25MHz ----
24: set_property PACKAGE_PIN T6 [get_ports gt_refclk_p]
25: set_property PACKAGE_PIN T5 [get_ports gt_refclk_n]
26: 
27: ## ---- init clock: onboard 100MHz diff (AK17/AK16) ----
28: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AK17 IOSTANDARD DIFF_HSTL_I_12} [get_ports init_clk_p]
29: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AK16 IOSTANDARD DIFF_HSTL_I_12} [get_ports init_clk_n]
30: 
31: ## ---- 系统 ----
32: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AC34 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports sys_rst_n]
33: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN Y30  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports key]
34: 
35: ## ---- RGMII GE1 (YT8531 PHY, 全部 LVCMOS18) ----
36: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AC31 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports eth_rxc]
37: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN Y33  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports eth_rx_ctl]
38: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN W33  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_rxd[0]}]
39: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN W34  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_rxd[1]}]
40: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN V33  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_rxd[2]}]
41: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AC32 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_rxd[3]}]
42: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN Y32  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports eth_txc]
43: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AE32 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports eth_tx_ctl]
44: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN Y31  IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_txd[0]}]
45: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AF32 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_txd[1]}]
46: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AF30 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_txd[2]}]
47: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AG30 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports {eth_txd[3]}]
48: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AA33 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports eth_rst_n]
49: 
50: ## ---- SFP 控制脚（SFPA = X1Y11，版本 A 索引 3；内环模式功能不敏感）----
51: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AF12 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33} [get_ports sfp_tx_disable]
52: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AF13 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33} [get_ports sfp_rs0]
53: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN AE13 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS33} [get_ports sfp_rs1]
54: 
55: ## ---- 观测 LED（T22/T23）----
56: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN T22 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports led_loop]
57: set_property -dict {PACKAGE_PIN T23 IOSTANDARD LVCMOS18} [get_ports led_link]
58: 
59: # =============================================================================
60: # 时钟域 / 例外约束 —— 照搬官方 example design 的 aurora_64b66b_0_exdes.xdc
61: # -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
62: # 为什么必须加：Vivado 默认对"无共同祖先"的时钟对**也**做建立/保持与恢复/移除分析。
63: #   本设计三个时钟互不相关：
64: #     eth_rxc  = PHY 晶振（RGMII 125M, 8 ns）
65: #     gt_refclk= MGTREFCLK1_226 156.25M（6.4 ns）→ 经 MMCM 生成 user_clk(~151.5M)
66: #     init_clk = 板载 100M 差分（10 ns）
67: #   所有跨域信号都已同步（帧泵格雷码指针双向 2FF、frame_len_mb 4 相握手邮箱、
68: #   wr_done_t/rd_done_t 翻转标志 2FF、复位同步链），故应声明为异步。
69: # 不加时的实测代价（首轮实现）: WNS=-2.661 ns，失败路径全部是
70: #   · u_aurora/bufg_gt_clr_delayed_reg → 各 tx_active/cdc 寄存器的 CLR（async_default 组）
71: #   · u_aurora/support_reset_logic_i 内部 *cdc_to* 同步器输入
72: #   · u_pump_rev 跨域指针/邮箱
73: #   这些路径的数据延时仅 0.3~0.4 ns，罚分几乎全来自时钟插入延迟差（SCD 4.3 vs DCD 1.8 ns）
74: #   —— 典型的"缺少时钟组声明"特征，而非真实逻辑太慢。
75: #
76: # 注意：XDC 文件里不能用 if / puts / foreach（Vivado 只支持受限 Tcl 子集，
77: #   实测会报 CRITICAL WARNING: [Designutils 20-1307] 且约束被整段丢弃）。
78: # =============================================================================
79: 
80: # --- 单组 -asynchronous = "本组与其余所有时钟互不相关"（含其派生时钟）---
81: #     gt_refclk 组含 MMCM 派生的 user_clk / sync_clk / tx_out_clk，
82: #     故这一行同时覆盖了 eth_rxc <-> user_clk 的全部跨域路径。
83: set_clock_groups -asynchronous -group [get_clocks init_clk  -include_generated_clocks]
84: set_clock_groups -asynchronous -group [get_clocks gt_refclk -include_generated_clocks]
85: 
86: # --- Aurora IP 内部 CDC 与 bufg_gt_clr 的例外（与 exdes 逐字一致）---
87: set_false_path -quiet -to [get_pins -quiet -hier *aurora_64b66b_0_cdc_to*/D]
88: set_false_path -quiet -through [get_pins -quiet -hier *bufg_gt_clr_delayed_reg*/Q]

(End of file - total 88 lines)

# =============================================================================
# 时钟域 / 例外约束 —— 照搬官方 example design 的 aurora_64b66b_0_exdes.xdc
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 为什么必须加：Vivado 默认对"无共同祖先"的时钟对**也**做建立/保持与恢复/移除分析。
#   本设计三个时钟互不相关：
#     eth_rxc  = PHY 晶振（RGMII 125M, 8 ns）
#     gt_refclk= MGTREFCLK1_226 156.25M（6.4 ns）→ 经 MMCM 生成 user_clk(~151.5M)
#     init_clk = 板载 100M 差分（10 ns）
#   所有跨域信号都已同步（帧泵格雷码指针双向 2FF、frame_len_mb 4 相握手邮箱、
#   wr_done_t/rd_done_t 翻转标志 2FF、复位同步链），故应声明为异步。
# 不加时的实测代价（首轮实现）: WNS=-2.661 ns，失败路径全部是
#   · u_aurora/bufg_gt_clr_delayed_reg → 各 tx_active/cdc 寄存器的 CLR（async_default 组）
#   · u_aurora/support_reset_logic_i 内部 *cdc_to* 同步器输入
#   · u_pump_rev 跨域指针/邮箱
#   这些路径的数据延时仅 0.3~0.4 ns，罚分几乎全来自时钟插入延迟差（SCD 4.3 vs DCD 1.8 ns）
#   —— 典型的"缺少时钟组声明"特征，而非真实逻辑太慢。
#
# 注意：XDC 文件里不能用 if / puts / foreach（Vivado 只支持受限 Tcl 子集，
#   实测会报 CRITICAL WARNING: [Designutils 20-1307] 且约束被整段丢弃）。
# =============================================================================

# --- 单组 -asynchronous = "本组与其余所有时钟互不相关"（含其派生时钟）---
#     gt_refclk 组含 MMCM 派生的 user_clk / sync_clk / tx_out_clk，
#     故这一行同时覆盖了 eth_rxc <-> user_clk 的全部跨域路径。
set_clock_groups -asynchronous -group [get_clocks init_clk  -include_generated_clocks]
set_clock_groups -asynchronous -group [get_clocks gt_refclk -include_generated_clocks]

set_false_path -quiet -to [get_pins -quiet -hier *aurora_64b66b_*_cdc_to*/D]   # prj9: 通配符覆盖 _0 与 _1 双核
set_false_path -quiet -through [get_pins -quiet -hier *bufg_gt_clr_delayed_reg*/Q]

#       + axis_word_pack / axis_word_unpack + 顶层 aurora_udp_bridge
#       + Aurora 64b/66b（共享逻辑在 example design → 必须一并加入 shared_logic）
# 用法（务必在 ASCII 工作目录）:
#   cd D:\FPGA\project_9
#   vivado -mode batch -source scripts\create_project.tcl -notrace
# =============================================================================
set proj_dir   D:/FPGA/project_9
set part_name  xcku060-ffva1156-2-i

create_project project_9 $proj_dir/prj -part $part_name -force

## ---- RTL（官方栈 15 + 帧泵 + 打包/解包 + 顶层）----
add_files -fileset sources_1 [glob $proj_dir/rtl/*.v $proj_dir/rtl/*/*.v]

## ---- Aurora 共享逻辑（shared logic in example design → 必须显式加入）----
add_files -fileset sources_1 [glob $proj_dir/shared_logic/*.v]

## ---- IP: import_ip（避免 read_ip 的生成物路径漂移，project_7 实录）----
import_ip $proj_dir/ip/aurora_64b66b_0/aurora_64b66b_0.xci
import_ip $proj_dir/ip/aurora_64b66b_0_reg_slice_0/aurora_64b66b_0_reg_slice_0.xci
import_ip $proj_dir/ip/aurora_64b66b_0_reg_slice_2/aurora_64b66b_0_reg_slice_2.xci
import_ip $proj_dir/ip/async_fifo_2048x8b/async_fifo_2048x8b.xci
import_ip $proj_dir/ip/aurora_64b66b_1/aurora_64b66b_1.xci

## ---- prj9: 回显弹性 FIFO（FWFT 同步 512x80b，fifo_generator）----
create_ip -name fifo_generator -vendor xilinx.com -library ip -version 13.2 -module_name fifo_80b_echo
set_property -dict [list \
    CONFIG.Fifo_Implementation {Common_Clock_Block_RAM} \
    CONFIG.Input_Data_Width {80} \
    CONFIG.Input_Depth {512} \
    CONFIG.Performance_Options {First_Word_Fall_Through} \
    CONFIG.Enable_Safety_Circuit {false} \
] [get_ips fifo_80b_echo]
generate_target all [get_ips]

## ---- 约束 ----
add_files -fileset constrs_1 $proj_dir/xdc/aurora_udp_bridge.xdc

## ---- 顶层 ----
set_property top aurora_udp_bridge [current_fileset]
update_compile_order -fileset sources_1

puts "CREATE_DONE: top=[get_property TOP [current_fileset]]"
puts "CREATE_DONE: ips=[get_ips]"

# ✅ 双笼版就绪——接线答案 + 测试流程

## 你问的“接哪两个”——最终答案

**光口 A（丝印 Y11）和 光口 B（丝印 Y9）**。板上四个笼子的完整映射（官方 55 号例程 XDC 注释 + GT LOC 双重证据锁定）：

| 丝印通道 | 光口 | GT | 控制脚 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A** ← 接 | **Y11** | X1Y11 | AF12/AE13/AF13 |
| **B** ← 接 | **Y9** | X1Y9 | AH12/AG11/AH11 |
| C | Y10 | X1Y10 | J25/M25/M26 |
| D | Y8 | X1Y8 | H26/H27/G27 |

**接法**：两个 10G SFP+ 模块分别插入 Y11、Y9 两笼，一根双工 LC 跳线连接两个模块——标准直连即 A.TX→B.RX / B.TX→A.RX。**若 T23 不亮，把跳线一端的两根纤对调再试**（极性反了链路起不来，对调无任何风险）。

## 双笼版做了什么（WNS=+1.008ns，构建全过）

既然要跨笼，只点亮 A 的 GT 不够——B 笼是黑的，A 的 Aurora 握手等不到对端。所以：

- **B 侧克隆了一个 Aurora IP**（`aurora_64b66b_1`，GT X1Y9），与 A 共用同一个 GT_COMMON/参考时钟（一个 quad 只允许一个 common，B 的支撑层做了“无 common”特化）
- **B 当“远端镜像”**：B 收到什么就在板内弹回什么（512×80b 弹性 FIFO 吸收 Aurora TX 的速率抖动）
- **数据渡光两次**：`A.TX →光→ B.RX →FIFO→ B.TX →光→ A.RX → 解包 → 回 PC`——A 侧数据通路（prj8 判据全过的那套泵/打包/解包）**一行未改**，而真链路证明比单渡更强：光路上任何误码都会被打两次，FCS 必抓
- **T23 = 双 channel_up 门控**（`link_ok`）：A、B 两链路都活才亮——这是“真链路建立”的硬指标

## 上板流程

1. 两个模块 + 跳线接好（如上）
2. 烧 `D:\FPGA\project_9\out\aurora_udp_bridge.bit`（`scripts\program_board.tcl`）
3. **看 T23**：常亮 = 双光链路 channel_up 建立 ✓（这本身就是物理层大里程碑）
4. T23 亮后跑老三样：`ping 192.168.1.10 -n 20` → `$env:PYTHONUTF8=1; python scripts\udp_verify.py` → 12/12 + Wireshark 截图

## 判读表

| 现象 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| T23 亮 + ping 通 | 真光链路全通 🎉 |
| T23 不亮 | 链路未建立：先对调跳线极性；再确认两模块都为 10G 型号；还不行我上 ILA 抓 `channel_up_b`/`echo_drop` |
| T23 亮 + ping 不通 | 光路通了、数据路径有问题：ILA 看 B 侧回显 FIFO 计数（`dbg_echo_drop`）与 A 侧 `rx_tvalid` |

⚠️ 一个注意：这个双笼位流**要求两个笼子都插模块**（`link_ok` 是双门控）。如果你哪天只想用一个模块 + 自环头测 A，告诉我，我把门控改回单通道再出一版。

tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Execute a TypeScript program against the available tools. Takes two required arguments: `code`, the BODY of an async function (erasable syntax only; top-level `await` and `return` work), and `description`, a short summary of what the program does. Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Only what you print or return is program output — curate it. Image-bearing subtool results are attached after the run.

code.description: The program: the body of an async TypeScript function.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this program does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "Count TODO markers across packages"; "Read failing test and its fixture"; "Rename config key in every cordis.yml".

The user asks: 总结现有的工程规范，写一版 agent.md，然后更新 readme (summarize the existing engineering conventions, write an agent.md, then update the readme).

No skill matches this task (writing project convention docs for an FPGA repo) — proceed directly.

Where should agent.md go? The workspace structure:
- Working directory: C:\Users\15266\Desktop\毕设 (the vault: 操作文档/, 短期待办.md, etc.)
- The FPGA repo: D:\FPGA (git-managed: project_7, project_8, project_9, ...)

"agent.md" — the convention file for AI agents working on the repo (like AGENTS.md convention). Given the engineering work lives in D:\FPGA, agent.md belongs at D:\FPGA\AGENTS.md? The user wrote "agent.md" lowercase. The convention popularized is AGENTS.md. I'll name it agent.md as the user asked (they said "写一版agent.md"). Location: D:\FPGA\agent.md — that's where an agent (me/future sessions) works on the projects. But wait — maybe they mean the 毕设 vault (C:\Users\15266\Desktop\毕设)? The vault holds docs; the repo holds code+scripts. The "工程规范" (engineering conventions) we've developed are mostly about the FPGA work: Vivado usage, file hygiene, board facts, first-principles rules, debug methodology. An agent.md for future AI sessions should live where future agents will start: D:\FPGA root (the git repo).

And "更新 readme" — which readme? Check what READMEs exist: D:\FPGA\readme.md? Let me check both D:\FPGA and the vault for existing readme files.

Content for agent.md — summarize the engineering conventions established across prj6→prj9 (from this session's accumulated context):

1. **事实源优先级 (first principles)**: 官方例程/官方XDC > 已验证 prj > AI 生成文档（仅参考）。Board params only from official examples/XDC/verified projects.
2. **官方文件保持原始**: never edit official RTL on disk; use same-name-module replacement via fileset (swap technique), or new derived files.
3. **工程结构**: each project dir with rtl/xdc/ip/shared_logic/scripts/out/docs; create_project.tcl → build_debug.tcl → program_board.tcl; ASCII paths only (Chinese path breaks Vivado Tcl/GBK).
4. **Vivado 规范**: 2023.1 batch mode; logs to files (GBK codepage issues); kill stale vivado processes before create -force; XDC limited Tcl subset (no if/foreach); TRIGGER_POSITION not accepted on hw_ila; import_ip not read_ip; generate_target.
5. **板级事实 (board facts)**: KU060 xcku060-ffva1156-2-i; JTAG Digilent 210512180081; NIC 192.168.1.102/24; board MAC 00:11:22:33:44:55 IP 192.168.1.10; RGMII GE1 pins; GT refclk T6/T5 156.25; init_clk AK17/16 100M; 光口映射 A=Y11=X1Y11(控制脚AF12/AE13/AF13), B=Y9=X1Y9(AH12/AG11/AH11), C=Y10, D=Y8; LEDs T22/T23; Aurora 10G line rate; rs0=rs1=1, tx_disable=0.
6. **已知坑 (pitfalls ledger)**: 
   - UltraScale 2023.1 absorbs BUFIO; IDELAY needs IDELAYCTRL; REQP-1816/1817; RGMII RX phase fix (rgmii_rx_fix2, RX_DLY_PS=1250)
   - 中文路径 GBK; pwsh quoting; fifo_generator param names; gt_pll_lock is core OUTPUT (MDRV); one GT_COMMON per quad; IBERT can't share GT with Aurora
   - pump rd_empty off-by-one; unpack mid-frame gap; source-port echo
   - mark_debug domain ownership (ILA cross-domain sampling = WNS killer); set_clock_groups async
7. **调试方法论**: 判别实验（官方位流对照）; ILA arm→traffic→upload→CSV 单会话; netlist autopsy (dcp compare); 判据 (ping/udp_verify 12/12, PYTHONUTF8=1); git commit per milestone; doc updates（调试记录/上板单/短期待办）.
8. **git 规范**: commits with detailed Chinese messages; commit msg via file -F; D:\FPGA repo.
9. **Python**: system python at C:\Users\15266\AppData\Local\Python\pythoncore-3.14-64\python.exe; PYTHONUTF8=1.
10. **验证判据**: hard criterion udp_verify 12/12; T23=channel_up gate; T22 sticky rx.

Also README update: what's the current readme? Let me check D:\FPGA for readme/README files. The readme should reflect current state: repo layout, projects status (prj6 网口栈 done, prj7 帧泵, prj8 数据级桥 M2 判据全过, prj9 双笼真光链路 current), how to build/program/verify, doc pointers.

Let me first look at existing files: D:\FPGA root listing + any readme; also vault readme? The user said "更新readme" implying one exists. Check D:\FPGA\*.md and vault root *.md.

# AGENTS.md — FPGA_Project 工程指令与规范（开发层，工作区 D:\FPGA）

> 本文件是开发层 Agent 的**常驻指令 + 工程规范汇总**（2026-09-18 重构：原「角色契约+滚动状态」改为「契约+规范沉淀」）。
> 你是工程状态的**唯一事实源**（契约见 vault `Agent 协作/开发协作文档.md`，用户转达）。
> 工程进度总览看 `README.md`；本文件管**怎么干活**。

## 一、角色与红线

### 角色分工（不变）
- **Reasonian（Obsidian）＝规划层**：vault 唯一写者（知识库/待办/方向）。
- **你（开发层）＝工程目录唯一写者**：状态以实测为准，主动如实汇报。
- **Reasonix（桌面端）＝协调中控**：任务路由、同步中枢↔本文件。同一时间仅一个活跃中控。

### 硬红线
1. **每步标注「为什么」**——用户答辩要讲得出原理，不允许只给结论。
2. **物理层归用户**：上板、光纤插拔、看示波器——你写操作清单并给出判读表，不代劳。
3. **改动可追溯**：一切改动走 git，提交信息写清意图与证据；位流/日志不入库（.gitignore）。
4. **工程路径全英文**：Vivado 对中文路径乱码（GBK 实证）。vault 文档中文没问题，Vivado Tcl 引用的路径必须 ASCII。
5. **用户是 FPGA 新手**：首次 GUI 环节（综合/看波形）提示用户亲自走一遍建立直觉。
6. ** vault 与工程目录双向开放**：改 vault 文档可以，但 vault 为权威版本、工程内只放脱敏快照。

## 二、事实源与第一性原则（本工程最高规范）

板级参数与设计的可信度排序，**只允许从高向低采信**：

```
官方例程/官方 XDC（正点原子 KU060例程 39/50/53/55 号等）
  > 已上板验证过的 prj（prj6 网口栈 / prj8 数据级桥 M2 判据全过版）
    > 板卡手册/引脚表（KU_IO.xdc，GBK 编码）
      > AI 生成的开发文档（仅参考，不可作为实现依据）
```

推论：
- 任何引脚/时序/IP 参数**先查官方例程 XDC 与已验证 prj 的 XDC**，找不到再问用户，最后才看 AI 文档。
- **官方 RTL 文件保持原样**（磁盘上的官方栈/Aurora 例程文件永不改）。修复手法二选一：
  ① **同名模块顶替**：新写 `xxx_fix.v`（module 名与官方一致），把官方文件从 fileset 移除、fix 加入（官方文件留在盘上）——prj8 `rgmii_rx_fix2.v` 即此法；
  ② **派生新文件**：复制官方文件→改模块名→只在派生版上动刀（`aurora_64b66b_0_support_ext.v` 即此法）。
- 判别实验优先：**怀疑实现层时先烧官方位流对照**（prj8 用官方 39 位流 ping 6/6 一举排除硬件，定位到实现层）。

## 三、硬件事实卡（实测定论，勿凭记忆改写）

| 项 | 事实 | 证据来源 |
|---|---|---|
| 器件 | `xcku060-ffva1156-2-i`（非 CIV）| 丝印+实现通过 |
| 系统时钟 | 100MHz 差分 AK17/AK16 | KU_IO.xdc |
| 复位 | AC34 低有效 LVCMOS18 | KU_IO.xdc |
| 网口 | GE1 RGMII（YT8531），栈时钟 eth_rxc 125M | 官方 39 XDC |
| ⚠️ RGMII RX | 2023.1 吸收官方 BUFIO→IDDRE1 挂全局钟，须 `rgmii_rx_fix2.v`（IDELAY **1250ps**+IDELAYCTRL） | prj8 网表解剖+延迟扫描 |
| Aurora 参考钟 | MGTREFCLK1_226（T6/T5）156.25MHz | IBERT 实测 |
| 光口映射 | **A=Y11=X1Y11 · B=Y9=X1Y9 · C=Y10=X1Y10 · D=Y8=X1Y8**（Quad X1Y2） | 官方 55 号 XDC 注释 + GT LOC 双证 |
| 光口控制脚 | A: tx_dis=AF12 rs0=AF13 rs1=AE13；B: AH12/AH11/AG11；C: J25/M26/M25；D: H26/G27/H27 | 官方 55 号 XDC |
| 光模块 | 须 10G SFP+（线速率 10G，RS0=RS1=1 高速档，tx_disable=0） | Aurora xci C_LINE_RATE=10 |
| LED | T22=观测（粘滞 rx）· T23=channel_up/link_ok（链路硬门控指示） | 各工程 XDC |
| JTAG | 调试烧录用 Diginet USB-JTAG；串口 FT2232H-B COM7 | hw_server 实测 |
| PC 侧 | NIC 192.168.1.102/24 静态 ↔ 板 192.168.1.10（MAC 00:11:22:33:44:55） | prj6 起 |
| Python | `C:\Users\15266\AppData\Local\Python\pythoncore-3.14-64\python.exe`，**须 `PYTHONUTF8=1`**（GBK 控制台打 ✓ 会崩） | udp_verify 实证 |

## 四、工程结构与脚本规范

```
D:\FPGA\project_N\
├── rtl/            # 设计 RTL（官方栈按子目录分 arp/ icmp/ udp/ gmii_to_rgmii/）
├── shared_logic/   # Aurora 例程共享逻辑（派生文件也放这，命名 *_ext/_shared）
├── ip/             # 只存 .xci（import_ip + generate_target 重新生成，产物不入 git）
├── xdc/            # 引脚+时钟组约束（引脚注释必须写来源）
├── scripts/        # Tcl 四件套 + py（见下）
├── out/            # 位流（gitignore）
└── docs/           # 工程级文档（设计说明/PROGRESS）
```

**脚本四件套（幂等，逐个可重跑）**：
1. `create_project.tcl`——建工程：`add_files` glob → `import_ip`（勿用 read_ip，prj7 实测路径漂移）→ `generate_target all`。
2. `build_debug.tcl`——综合+ILA 插入+实现+出流：输出 `TIMING:`（WNS）与 `DBG_BUILD_DONE:` 标记行供日志抓取。
3. `program_board.tcl`——hw_server 烧录（成功标记 `PROGRAM_OK`）。
4. `board_test_*.ps1`——一键「烧录→ping→udp_verify」判据跑。

**规范**：日志落文件再 Select-String（勿管道直取——回显行会污染）；`create_project -force` 前先杀残留 vivado 进程（锁 runs 目录是实坑）；python 一律 `PYTHONUTF8=1`。

## 五、RTL/设计规范

1. **CDC 只有三种合法形式**：帧泵式格雷指针异步 FIFO、2FF 同步器（打拍≥2）、4 相握手邮箱。新跨域路径必须三选一。
2. **mark_debug 探针标注时钟域**，ILAs 挂同名域——跨域采样探针曾是 WNS=-2.6ns 的元凶（prj8 首轮实证）。
   B 通道（user_clk_b 域）探针绝不能挂 A 域（user_clk）ILA。
3. **互不相关时钟必须声明时钟组**：`set_clock_groups -asynchronous`（eth_rxc / gt_refclk 派生 / init_clk 三组），否则跨域路径被假同步分析重罚。
4. **XDC 只用受限 Tcl**：不能 `if/foreach/puts`（实测整段丢弃，CRITICAL WARNING [Designutils 20-1307]）。参数化约束改在 Tcl 脚本里生成。
5. **判据无旁路原则**：数据通路必须被链路状态硬门控（`aurora_rst=~sys_rst_n|~channel_up`）——链路没起来板子对外静默，判据通过 ⇔ 数据真的穿过了链路。
6. **一个 quad 只允许一个 GT_COMMON**：多 Aurora 同 quad 时，第一个实例的 support 引出 refclk+QPLL 四件套（`_ext`），兄弟实例用无 common 的 `_shared` 版；各实例私有 MMCM 时钟模块与复位逻辑。
7. **Aurora 核端口方向**：`gt_pll_lock` 是核的**状态输出口**（外部 assign 驱动它 = MDRV-1）；外部锁定状态只走 `gt_qplllock_quad1_in`。
8. IP 参数不确定时**只设置有把握的**——set_property 遇到不存在的参数名是致命错（fifo_generator 实坑）。

## 六、调试方法论（按代价升序）

1. **判别实验**：换已知好的位流（官方例程）对照，先分「硬件 vs 实现」。
2. **ILA 单会话三段式**：同一 Vivado batch 会话内 arm → 起流量（ping）→ upload → CSV。arming 易失，**不能跨会话**。触发探针名要与 probes.ltx 一致；`TRIGGER_POSITION` 属性不被接受（省略或 catch）。
3. **网表解剖**：`open_checkpoint` 两份 dcp 对比元件/位置/绑定（prj8 定位 BUFIO 被吸收即此法）。
4. **延迟扫描**：时序边缘问题时改一个参数出一流（IDELAY 500→1250ps 即收敛过程），每次记录 ping 通过率。
5. 每轮调试落**调试记录**（现象→假设→实验→证据→结论五要素），入 vault `操作文档/调试记录_*.md`。

## 七、验证判据规范

**三层证明力**（每层通过才算闭环）：
| 层 | 命令 | 通过标准 | 证明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 链路 | 看 T23 | 常亮 | channel_up（硬门控前提）|
| 通路 | `ping 192.168.1.10 -n 20` | 0% 丢包 全 <1ms | ARP+ICMP 穿 Aurora 往返 |
| 数据 | `$env:PYTHONUTF8=1; python scripts\udp_verify.py [次数]` | **回显一致 12/12** | payload 逐字节原样返回 |
| 佐证 | Wireshark 抓 `udp.port==1234` | 请求/回显成对且 payload 相同 | 帧级眼见为实 |

`udp_verify.py` 的 12 个长度（26~33/40/63/100/200）是刻意选的——**覆盖帧长%8 全部余数类**，专压打包/解包尾部处理。跑前关闭占用 1234 端口的程序。

## 八、git 与文档规范

- **每个里程碑一提交**，信息含：改了什么/为什么/WNS/判据结果。多行信息写临时文件 `git commit -F`，提交后删。
- 提交语义前缀：`project_N:`（工程主线）/ `project_N fix:`（修根因）/ `docs:`（文档）。
- vault 文档快照入 `docs/操作文档/` 须脱敏（用户名→`***`，人名→`前辈`）；命名 `[阶段]_prj标识_概要_YYYY-MM-DD`。
- 工程状态变化 → 更新 README「当前推进」+ 向用户报告一句；中枢同步归中控。

## 九、坑账本（踩过的坑 = 规范的来源）

| # | 坑 | 根因与修法 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 中文路径 Tcl 报 File not found | GBK 码位问题；官方位流拷到 ASCII 路径再操作 |
| 2 | XDC 里写 if/foreach 被整段丢弃 | XDC 是受限 Tcl；逻辑放 build 脚本 |
| 3 | 帧尾总丢 1 字节（FCS 坏） | 帧泵 `rd_empty` 误用 `rd_bin_next` 提前判空——用当前 `rd_bin`（prj8 commit ae40965）|
| 4 | 回显帧中段断裂 | unpack 对帧中断流敏感——改整帧存储转发（09-10）|
| 5 | RX 字节「只 1→0」子集损伤 | 2023.1 吸收 BUFIO，IDDRE1 挂 BUFGCE 全局钟压位边界——FIXED IDELAY 1250ps×5 + IDELAYCTRL（065ee78/66ff43d）|
| 6 | PLIDC-10 / REQP-1816 / 1817 | IDELAY 必须配 IDELAYCTRL，其 RST 不得接地也不得直连 LOCKED——用 clk200 打拍同步链 |
| 7 | WNS=-2.6ns 假路径罚分 | 探针跨域采样 + 缺时钟组声明——mark_debug 标域 + set_clock_groups |
| 8 | MDRV-1 QPLL1LOCK 多驱动 | Aurora 核 `gt_pll_lock` 是输出口，外部不可驱动（42f0ba2 踩坑实录）|
| 9 | create_project -force 失败 | 残留 vivado 进程锁 runs 目录——先 Stop-Process vivado |
| 10 | fifo_generator set_property 致命错 | 参数名臆造（Write_Depth_Flag 等）不存在——只设有把握的参数 |
| 11 | hw_ila 属性拒绝 | TRIGGER_POSITION 不被接受——省略或 catch 包裹 |
| 12 | python 打印 ✓ 崩溃 | GBK 控制台——`PYTHONUTF8=1` |
| 13 | IBERT 与 Aurora 抢 GT | 同一 GT 通道不能二者并存——换装位流或用同 quad 空闲通道 |
| 14 | 位流断电即失 | JTAG 烧录易失——每次上电重烧（board_test 一键脚本兜底）|

## 十、当前工程状态（一屏速览，详表见 README.md）

- ✅ prj6 网口栈（09-04）· ✅ prj8 数据级桥 M2 判据全过（09-18，git 66ff43d）
- 🔄 **prj9 双笼真光链路**（git 42f0ba2，WNS=+1.008ns，位流就绪）：双 10G 模块插 **A(Y11)/B(Y9)** + LC 跳线直连 → T23（link_ok=双 channel_up）常亮 → 判据同 M2。T23 不亮先对调一端两纤。
- ⏭️ 连通后：IBERT 眼图（空闲通道 C/D）→ 双板干线 → DDR/DMA 解冻
- ⏸️ 挂起区：project_4 MIG · 串口桥三级验证 · project_7 内环 · 8b/10b 练手（恢复触发条件见 README）

## 十一、同步约定（不变）

- 本文件 = 工程侧唯一执行版；vault `Agent 协作/AI协作中枢.md` = 中控维护的状态视图（可能滞后，以实测为准）。

- **Reasonix（桌面端）＝协调中控**：任务路由、同步中枢↔本文件。同一时间仅一个活跃中控。

### 硬红线
1. **每步标注「为什么」**——用户答辩要讲得出原理，不允许只给结论。
2. **物理层归用户**：上板、光纤插拔、看示波器——你写操作清单并给出判读表，不代劳。
3. **改动可追溯**：一切改动走 git，提交信息写清意图与证据；位流/日志不入库（.gitignore）。
4. **工程路径全英文**：Vivado 对中文路径乱码（GBK 实证）。vault 文档中文没问题，Vivado Tcl 引用的路径必须 ASCII。
5. **用户是 FPGA 新手**：首次 GUI 环节（综合/看波形）提示用户亲自走一遍建立直觉。
6. ** vault 与工程目录双向开放**：改 vault 文档可以，但 vault 为权威版本、工程内只放脱敏快照。

## 二、事实源与第一性原则（本工程最高规范）

板级参数与设计的可信度排序，**只允许从高向低采信**：

```
官方例程/官方 XDC（正点原子 KU060例程 39/50/53/55 号等）
  > 已上板验证过的 prj（prj6 网口栈 / prj8 数据级桥 M2 判据全过版）
    > 板卡手册/引脚表（KU_IO.xdc，GBK 编码）
      > AI 生成的开发文档（仅参考，不可作为实现依据）
```

推论：
- 任何引脚/时序/IP 参数**先查官方例程 XDC 与已验证 prj 的 XDC**，找不到再问用户，最后才看 AI 文档。
- **官方 RTL 文件保持原样**（磁盘上的官方栈/Aurora 例程文件永不改）。修复手法二选一：
  ① **同名模块顶替**：新写 `xxx_fix.v`（module 名与官方一致），把官方文件从 fileset 移除、fix 加入（官方文件留在盘上）——prj8 `rgmii_rx_fix2.v` 即此法；
  ② **派生新文件**：复制官方文件→改模块名→只在派生版上动刀（`aurora_64b66b_0_support_ext.v` 即此法）。
- 判别实验优先：**怀疑实现层时先烧官方位流对照**（prj8 用官方 39 位流 ping 6/6 一举排除硬件，定位到实现层）。

## 四、工程结构与脚本规范

```
D:\FPGA\project_N\
├── rtl/            # 设计 RTL（官方栈按子目录分 arp/ icmp/ udp/ gmii_to_rgmii/）
├── shared_logic/   # Aurora 例程共享逻辑（派生文件也放这，命名 *_ext/_shared）
├── ip/             # 只存 .xci（import_ip + generate_target 重新生成，产物不入 git）
├── xdc/            # 引脚+时钟组约束（引脚注释必须写来源）
├── scripts/        # Tcl 四件套 + py（见下）
├── out/            # 位流（gitignore）
└── docs/           # 工程级文档（设计说明/PROGRESS）
```

**脚本四件套（幂等，逐个可重跑）**：
1. `create_project.tcl`——建工程：`add_files` glob → `import_ip`（勿用 read_ip，prj7 实测路径漂移）→ `generate_target all`。
2. `build_debug.tcl`——综合+ILA 插入+实现+出流：输出 `TIMING:`（WNS）与 `DBG_BUILD_DONE:` 标记行供日志抓取。
3. `program_board.tcl`——hw_server 烧录（成功标记 `PROGRAM_OK`）。
4. `board_test_*.ps1`——一键「烧录→ping→udp_verify」判据跑。

**规范**：日志落文件再 Select-String（勿管道直取——回显行会污染）；`create_project -force` 前先杀残留 vivado 进程（锁 runs 目录是实坑）；python 一律 `PYTHONUTF8=1`。

## 五、RTL/设计规范

1. **CDC 只有三种合法形式**：帧泵式格雷指针异步 FIFO、2FF 同步器（打拍≥2）、4 相握手邮箱。新跨域路径必须三选一。
2. **mark_debug 探针标注时钟域**，ILAs 挂同名域——跨域采样探针曾是 WNS=-2.6ns 的元凶（prj8 首轮实证）。
   B 通道（user_clk_b 域）探针绝不能挂 A 域（user_clk）ILA。
3. **互不相关时钟必须声明时钟组**：`set_clock_groups -asynchronous`（eth_rxc / gt_refclk 派生 / init_clk 三组），否则跨域路径被假同步分析重罚。
4. **XDC 只用受限 Tcl**：不能 `if/foreach/puts`（实测整段丢弃，CRITICAL WARNING [Designutils 20-1307]）。参数化约束改在 Tcl 脚本里生成。
5. **判据无旁路原则**：数据通路必须被链路状态硬门控（`aurora_rst=~sys_rst_n|~channel_up`）——链路没起来板子对外静默，判据通过 ⇔ 数据真的穿过了链路。
6. **一个 quad 只允许一个 GT_COMMON**：多 Aurora 同 quad 时，第一个实例的 support 引出 refclk+QPLL 四件套（`_ext`），兄弟实例用无 common 的 `_shared` 版；各实例私有 MMCM 时钟模块与复位逻辑。
7. **Aurora 核端口方向**：`gt_pll_lock` 是核的**状态输出口**（外部 assign 驱动它 = MDRV-1）；外部锁定状态只走 `gt_qplllock_quad1_in`。
8. IP 参数不确定时**只设置有把握的**——set_property 遇到不存在的参数名是致命错（fifo_generator 实坑）。

## 六、调试方法论（按代价升序）

1. **判别实验**：换已知好的位流（官方例程）对照，先分「硬件 vs 实现」。
2. **ILA 单会话三段式**：同一 Vivado batch 会话内 arm → 起流量（ping）→ upload → CSV。arming 易失，**不能跨会话**。触发探针名要与 probes.ltx 一致；`TRIGGER_POSITION` 属性不被接受（省略或 catch）。
3. **网表解剖**：`open_checkpoint` 两份 dcp 对比元件/位置/绑定（prj8 定位 BUFIO 被吸收即此法）。
4. **延迟扫描**：时序边缘问题时改一个参数出一流（IDELAY 500→1250ps 即收敛过程），每次记录 ping 通过率。
5. 每轮调试落**调试记录**（现象→假设→实验→证据→结论五要素），入 vault `操作文档/调试记录_*.md`。

## 七、验证判据规范

**三层证明力**（每层通过才算闭环）：
| 层 | 命令 | 通过标准 | 证明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 链路 | 看 T23 | 常亮 | channel_up（硬门控前提）|
| 通路 | `ping 192.168.1.10 -n 20` | 0% 丢包 全 <1ms | ARP+ICMP 穿 Aurora 往返 |
| 数据 | `$env:PYTHONUTF8=1; python scripts\udp_verify.py [次数]` | **回显一致 12/12** | payload 逐字节原样返回 |
| 佐证 | Wireshark 抓 `udp.port==1234` | 请求/回显成对且 payload 相同 | 帧级眼见为实 |

`udp_verify.py` 的 12 个长度（26~33/40/63/100/200）是刻意选的——**覆盖帧长%8 全部余数类**，专压打包/解包尾部处理。跑前关闭占用 1234 端口的程序。

## 八、git 与文档规范

- **每个里程碑一提交**，信息含：改了什么/为什么/WNS/判据结果。多行信息写临时文件 `git commit -F`，提交后删。
- 提交语义前缀：`project_N:`（工程主线）/ `project_N fix:`（修根因）/ `docs:`（文档）。
- vault 文档快照入 `docs/操作文档/` 须脱敏（用户名→`***`，人名→`前辈`）；命名 `[阶段]_prj标识_概要_YYYY-MM-DD`。
- 工程状态变化 → 更新 README「当前推进」+ 向用户报告一句；中枢同步归中控。

## 九、坑账本（踩过的坑 = 规范的来源）

| # | 坑 | 根因与修法 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 中文路径 Tcl 报 File not found | GBK 码位问题；官方位流拷到 ASCII 路径再操作 |
| 2 | XDC 里写 if/foreach 被整段丢弃 | XDC 是受限 Tcl；逻辑放 build 脚本 |
| 3 | 帧尾总丢 1 字节（FCS 坏） | 帧泵 `rd_empty` 误用 `rd_bin_next` 提前判空——用当前 `rd_bin`（prj8 commit ae40965）|
| 4 | 回显帧中段断裂 | unpack 对帧中断流敏感——改整帧存储转发（09-10）|
| 5 | RX 字节「只 1→0」子集损伤 | 2023.1 吸收 BUFIO，IDDRE1 挂 BUFGCE 全局钟压位边界——FIXED IDELAY 1250ps×5 + IDELAYCTRL（065ee78/66ff43d）|
| 6 | PLIDC-10 / REQP-1816 / 1817 | IDELAY 必须配 IDELAYCTRL，其 RST 不得接地也不得直连 LOCKED——用 clk200 打拍同步链 |
| 7 | WNS=-2.6ns 假路径罚分 | 探针跨域采样 + 缺时钟组声明——mark_debug 标域 + set_clock_groups |
| 8 | MDRV-1 QPLL1LOCK 多驱动 | Aurora 核 `gt_pll_lock` 是输出口，外部不可驱动（42f0ba2 踩坑实录）|
| 9 | create_project -force 失败 | 残留 vivado 进程锁 runs 目录——先 Stop-Process vivado |
| 10 | fifo_generator set_property 致命错 | 参数名臆造（Write_Depth_Flag 等）不存在——只设有把握的参数 |
| 11 | hw_ila 属性拒绝 | TRIGGER_POSITION 不被接受——省略或 catch 包裹 |
| 12 | python 打印 ✓ 崩溃 | GBK 控制台——`PYTHONUTF8=1` |
| 13 | IBERT 与 Aurora 抢 GT | 同一 GT 通道不能二者并存——换装位流或用同 quad 空闲通道 |
| 14 | 位流断电即失 | JTAG 烧录易失——每次上电重烧（board_test 一键脚本兜底）|

## 十、当前工程状态（一屏速览，详表见 README.md）

- ✅ prj6 网口栈（09-04）· ✅ prj8 数据级桥 M2 判据全过（09-18，git 66ff43d）

- ⏭️ 连通后：IBERT 眼图（空闲通道 C/D）→ 双板干线 → DDR/DMA 解冻

- 本文件 = 工程侧唯一执行版；vault `Agent 协作/AI协作中枢.md` = 中控维护的状态视图（可能滞后，以实测为准）。

# FPGA_Project — 毕设 FPGA 工程（工程索引）

多 Agent 协同推理的 FPGA 交换节点：Kintex UltraScale **XCKU060** 实现**标准以太网 + 高速光互连**数据交换（缓存/直通双模式转发），参考 MoA 架构（ICLR 2025）。

**架构定位（2026-09-04 定版）**：端点/上位机通信 = **标准以太网（千兆）**；Aurora 64b/66b = **板间干线**（单板阶段用于数据级验证，接入多块板组交换网络时作为板间 10G 互联）。

> **给 Agent/协作者**：工程规范（事实源优先级、硬件事实卡、CDC/ILA/XDC 规范、调试方法论、坑账本）见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。

## 里程碑

- ✅ **M1（2026-08-11）**：Vitis 导入硬件平台，Hello World 串口打印成功（COM7@9600）
- ✅ **IBERT 物理层（2026-08-27）**：10G PRBS 跨口跳线过纤，PLL Locked + 0E0（眼图已归档）
- ✅ **Aurora 64b/66b 链路层（2026-08-31）**：内部环回，channel_up/lane_up/误码全 0（ILA）
- ✅ **以太网上位机通道（2026-09-04）**：UDP/ARP/ICMP 栈 + 抓包验证（ping / 回环 / 四包链）
- ✅ **M2 数据级桥（2026-09-18）**：PC UDP 数据穿越 Aurora 64b/66b 编解码往返——ping 10/10+20/20 全 <1ms、udp_verify 12/12 + 压力 36/36 逐字节一致；三根因（unpack 断流 / 帧泵 rd_empty off-by-one / RGMII RX 采样相位）全部修复闭环
- 🔄 **当前推进：真光链路（project_9）**——去内环（loopback 3'b000）+ 双笼 A↔B 版位流已产出（WNS=+1.008ns），待接线验证
- ⏳ 后续：IBERT 眼图（空闲通道 C/Y10、D/Y8）→ 双板干线 → DDR/DMA 解冻 → 双模式转发 → 性能测量

## 当前推进（2026-09-18）

**project_9 · 真光链路版（Aurora 去 3'b010 内环）**
- 单笼版（X1Y11）：首版位流 WNS=+0.936ns
- **双笼版（A↔B 真光链路）**：A=Y11=X1Y11 + B=Y9=X1Y9（引脚见 `docs/参考_cross_FMC_4SFP_GTH引脚表_2026-08-27.md`）；克隆 Aurora IP → `aurora_64b66b_1`；B 侧远端镜像 + 512×80b FWFT 回显 FIFO，**数据渡光两次**（A.TX→B.RX→FIFO→B.TX→A.RX），A 侧数据通路零改动；位流 `out/aurora_udp_bridge.bit`（WNS=+1.008ns）
- **待办（物理层归用户）**：两个 10G 模块插 A/B 两笼，LC 跳线直连 → 烧双笼版位流 → T23（link_ok=channel_up_a&channel_up_b）常亮 → ping/udp_verify 同 M2 判据；T23 不亮先把一端两纤对调。仅一个模块时插 A + LC 自环头走单笼自环。

- part = **`xcku060-ffva1156-2-i`（非 CIV）**；100MHz 差分晶振（AK17/AK16）；复位 AC34（低有效）
- 板载网口：双千兆 RGMII（GE1/GE2，YT8531 PHY）；FMC 四光口（GT Quad X1Y2，A=X1Y11，参考钟 T6/T5@156.25MHz）
- JTAG：板载 FT2232H；本机调试烧录走 Digilent USB-JTAG（210512180081，hw_server 自动识别）；串口 = FT2232H-B 通道（COM7，注册表 SERIALCOMM 实证）

## PC 侧验证三板斧（判据闭环）

```powershell
# 0) 断电重上电后位流易失 → 重烧（一键判据脚本）
powershell -File D:\FPGA\project_9\scripts\board_test_*.ps1
# 1) 链路：T23 常亮（channel_up / link_ok 硬门控）
# 2) 通路：
ping 192.168.1.10 -n 20          # 0% 丢包、全 <1ms
# 3) 数据（⚠️ 先关占用 1234 端口的程序）：
$env:PYTHONUTF8 = 1              # 必须！GBK 控制台打 ✓ 会崩
cd D:\FPGA\project_9
python scripts\udp_verify.py    # 回显一致 12/12（长度覆盖 帧长%8 全部余数类）
```

佐证：Wireshark 过滤 `udp.port==1234`，请求/回显成对且 payload 相同。三层证明力：T23=链路、ping=通路、udp_verify=数据完整性。

4. 批处理构建：`vivado -mode batch -source <script>.tcl`（幂等脚本见各工程 `scripts\`；⚠️ 需在纯 ASCII 工作目录运行）

## 硬件基线（实测定论）

- part = **`xcku060-ffva1156-2-i`（非 CIV）**；100MHz 差分晶振（AK17/AK16）；复位 AC34（低有效）
- 板载网口：双千兆 RGMII（GE1/GE2，YT8531 PHY）；FMC 四光口（GT Quad X1Y2，A=X1Y11，参考钟 T6/T5@156.25MHz）
- JTAG：板载 FT2232H；本机调试烧录走 Digilent USB-JTAG（210512180081，hw_server 自动识别）；串口 = FT2232H-B 通道（COM7，注册表 SERIALCOMM 实证）

# 毕设文档目录 — 索引

课题：**FPGA 高速互联网络平台设计与实现**——Kintex UltraScale XCKU060 上构建多 Agent 协同推理的数据交换平台，重点为 FPGA 网络层优化（缓存/直通转发、Fat-Tree 多路径、拥塞感知负载分发）。硬件无硬核 ARM，以 MicroBlaze 软核替代基线工程（ZCU102）的 PS。

> 工程代码与规范在 `D:\FPGA\`（git 管理）：工程状态看 `D:\FPGA\README.md`，工程规范看 `D:\FPGA\AGENTS.md`。
> AI 开发会话入口：本目录 `agent.md`。

## 目录地图

| 目录 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| `8.3/` | 开发主线资料：导师会议纪要、5 阶段任务分工、8 篇多智能体论文拆解、基线工程资料 |
| `毕设方向与论文大纲/` | 课题定位、论文大纲、方案演进（V1→V4） |
| `操作文档/` | 各阶段实操单与调试记录；`操作文档/挂起/` 为挂起课题收纳区 |
| `汇报/` | 组会分享与进度汇报（md/pptx/pdf）|
| `笔记和开发指南/` | 板卡手册研读笔记：光纤接口眼图、8b10b、Aurora AXIS 约定、开发指南提取件 |
| `截图归档/` | 上板截图 |
| `Agent 协作/` | 历史归档（旧协作契约，2026-09-20 废弃，仅供追溯）|
| `归档/` | 已被取代的旧版文档 |
| 根目录 | `README.md`（本索引）· `agent.md`（AI 会话入口）· `追踪_cross_短期待办_2026-08-03.md`（任务清单）· `规划_cross_长期路线图_2026-09-04.md`（路线基准）|

## 命名规范

文件名 `[阶段]_prj标识_概要_YYYY-MM-DD.md`；跨目录引用加 `cross` 前缀；日期取文件头 `created` 字段。仓库侧全文见 `D:\FPGA\AGENTS.md`「git 与文档规范」。

|---|---|---|
| M1 MicroBlaze 最小系统 | ✅ 2026-08-11 | Hello World 串口（COM7@9600）|
| IBERT 光口自检 | ✅ 2026-08-27 | SFPA 自环 PLL Locked + 0E0；定版 Quad X1Y2 / 参考钟 T6/T5@156.25 / 控制脚版本 A |
| Aurora 链路层 | ✅ 2026-08-31 | 近端 PMA 内环，channel_up/lane_up=1、误码全 0 |
| 以太网 UDP 网口栈 | ✅ 2026-09-04 | prj6 上板：ping + UDP 回显逐字节一致 + Wireshark 四包链 |
| **M2 数据级桥** | ✅ 2026-09-18 | prj8：ping 10/10+20/20、udp_verify 12/12+压力 36/36；三根因修复闭环 |
| **prj9 真光链路** | 🔄 位流就绪 | 双笼 A↔B（数据渡光两次）WNS=+1.008ns，待接线验证 |

- 挂起课题（4）：8b/10b 练手 · MIG/DDR4（位流在库待解冻）· 串口桥（M-D 未收）· prj7 UDP+SFP 内环。详见 `操作文档/挂起/`。
- 官方例程源码库：`D:\BaiduNetdiskDownload\1_Verilog\KU060例程\`（56 章，GBK）。以太网相关：37/38/**39（prj6 移植源）**/40/48/**53（SFP 光口版）**/54-56（SFP 10G 系列）。

## 阅读路径

1. 为什么做：`毕设方向与论文大纲/7.18 最新方向` → `毕设方向与论文大纲/面向边缘联邦学习的FPGA高速互联网络平台设计与实现`

3. 当前做什么：`追踪_cross_短期待办_2026-08-03` → `操作文档/`（最新实操单/调试记录）→ `操作文档/挂起/README`
4. 基线工程：`8.3/2026-04-30/FPGA-SFP-communication-with-Aurora 项目详细介绍`
5. 论文基底：`8.3/智能体互联网/论文拆解汇总_8篇`（MoA 为重点）

## 工程红线（摘要，全文见 `D:\FPGA\AGENTS.md`）

tools.description: Execute a TypeScript program against the available tools. code.description: The program: the body of an async TypeScript function.

content.text:
The user is ready to do prj9 board-level testing (双笼 A↔B 真光链路). This is the physical wiring + programming + verification moment.

Per AGENTS.md red lines: 物理层归用户 — I write the operation checklist + 判读表, the user does the physical work. But programming the board via JTAG and running ping/udp_verify from this PC is MY domain (established in prj8 sessions — I've done program+ping+verify repeatedly; the user considers this acceptable since it's software-side; the "physical" part = inserting modules/fiber/power).

The skill catalog reminder — no relevant skill for FPGA board testing. Proceed directly.

Plan for this turn:
1. Confirm the current state: bitstream exists (D:\FPGA\project_9\out\aurora_udp_bridge.bit, dual-cage version from build9e), verify timestamp/WNS quickly
2. Give the user the pre-flight physical checklist (插模块、接跳线、上电) — they need to do physical steps
3. After they confirm hardware ready, I burn the bitstream + verify (T23 via... can't see LEDs — T23 observation is user's; but I CAN infer link status via ILA or just ping. Actually channel_up can be read via ILA — but simplest: program → wait → ping. If ping works, link is up (T23 must be lit). If ping fails, check ILA for channel_up/channel_up_b)

Wait — the user said "我现在准备进行prj9的上板" — they're about to start. So I should:
- Give the concise checklist (what to plug where)
- Ask them to confirm when hardware is wired
- Then I take over: program + verify

Actually since they say "准备进行" — let me give the checklist AND ask for confirmation of the physical setup. Key physical steps:
1. 断电状态下：两个 10G SFP+ 模块分别插 A(Y11) 和 B(Y9) 笼子（注意丝印/方向，模块有防呆缺口）
2. 双工 LC 跳线连接两个模块（A 的两口 ↔ B 的两口，标准直连）
3. 网线接 GE1（和之前一样）
4. JTAG 线接好
5. 上电

Then my part: program prj9 bit → wait 3s → user reports T23 → ping → udp_verify.

Also prepare the fallback: if T23 dark → swap fibers at one end.

One more consideration: the board might currently be running the prj8 bit (M2 version) from last time (if still powered) — irrelevant, we'll reprogram.

Also verify the prj9 bit file is intact before programming. Let me check file exists + timestamp quickly, then present the checklist.

Let me also prepare a one-shot script for this test (like board_test_rxfix.ps1 but for prj9) — actually program_board.tcl already points at prj9 out. A simple command sequence suffices; no need for a new script file yet.

Keep it tight: verify bit, give checklist, wait for confirmation.
好——prj9 双笼版上板。先确认位流在位，然后给你物理操作清单：

Bitstream confirmed: 09-18 22:18, WNS +1.008ns, dual-cage version (build9e). 

Now give the user the physical checklist. Physical ops belong to the user (red line). I need them to:
1. Insert two 10G SFP+ modules into cages A (Y11) and B (Y9)
2. Connect duplex LC jumper between the two modules
3. Ensure Ethernet GE1 + JTAG connected
4. Power on

Then confirm to me → I program + verify.

Keep the message tight and actionable. No need for ask_user_question (they'll reply naturally when ready). Actually — a question with options could be efficient ("接好了/接不上/模块不确定")... but plain instruction + wait for their reply is fine and less friction. They're an active participant.

位流确认在位（09-18 22:18，WNS=+1.008ns，双笼版）。**物理操作清单**（这部分归你）：

## 接线清单（断电状态下操作）

| 步骤 | 操作 | 要点 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 两个 **10G SFP+ 模块**分别插入 **A 笼（丝印 Y11）** 和 **B 笼（丝印 Y9）** | 模块有防呆缺口，插到位会“咔”一声卡住拉环 |
| 2 | **双工 LC 跳线**连接两个模块 | 标准直连即可（A 的两口 ↔ B 的两口，不用交叉）|
| 3 | 网线接 **GE1**（和 prj8 验证时同一个口），JTAG 线接好 | PC 端不用动，仍是 192.168.1.102 |
| 4 | **上电** | |

三个提醒：
- **模块必须是 10G 的**（SFP+ 规格，如 10GBASE-SR/LR）——1.25G/4.25G 模块撑不住 10G 线速，链路起不来
- 光纤跳线类型要配模块：SR(850nm 多模) 配 MMF 跳线，LR(1310nm 单模) 配 SMF 跳线；两端模块最好同型号
- 丝印看不清的话：四个笼子里 **A=Y11 是 prj8 一直在用的那个**，B=Y9 与它相邻

## 接好后我来跑的部分

你回一句“接好了”，我就执行：烧 prj9 位流 → 你看 **T23 是否常亮**（这是双光链路 channel_up 的硬指标）→ ping ×20 → udp_verify 12/12 + Wireshark。

**判读预案**：
- T23 不亮 → 先把跳线一端的两根纤**对调**（极性反是最常见原因），我重烧后再看
- T23 亮但 ping 不通 → 我上 ILA 抓 `channel_up_b` / `echo_drop` / A 侧 `rx_tvalid` 定位
- 两个模块指示灯（如有）也是线索：TX 常亮/闪烁 = 激光在工作

等你的“接好了”。

User asks two things:
1. Bitstream path so they can burn it themselves
2. Is it normal that the Ethernet port LEDs are not lit after power-on?

Answer:

**1. Bitstream path**: `D:\FPGA\project_9\out\aurora_udp_bridge.bit`
They can burn via Vivado GUI Hardware Manager: Open Hardware Manager → Open target → Program Device → select bit file. Or they can use the script `D:\FPGA\project_9\scripts\program_board.tcl` (batch). Since they asked to do it themselves, give both options.

**2. Ethernet port LED not lit after power-on — is it normal?**

Analysis: The board just powered on. No bitstream is loaded yet (or old volatile bitstream lost on power cycle). Without a bitstream:
- The FPGA doesn't drive the RGMII interface
- eth_rst_n (PHY reset) is not driven → PHY in reset or released but no clock/data activity
- PHY won't establish link with PC → link LED off, activity LED off → **completely normal** before programming

Also recall prj8 board report earlier: "以太网口黄灯常亮，绿灯没亮" when the OLD bitstream was on and things were half-working. Now after fresh power-up with NO bitstream: both LEDs off is expected.

Expected LED sequence:
- Before programming: Ethernet LEDs off (no bitstream → no PHY management, no link)
- After programming prj9 bit: 
  - Wait: with the dual-cage bitstream, link_ok gates... hmm — actually what drives the Ethernet link? The PHY (YT8531) does auto-negotiation with the PC NIC autonomously once out of reset — eth_rst_n is driven by the FPGA top (`assign eth_rst_n = sys_rst_n`) — so after programming, PHY comes out of reset, auto-negotiates 1Gbps with PC → Ethernet LEDs (yellow=link, green=activity presumably) light up REGARDLESS of Aurora channel state (PHY link is independent of the data path).
  - So after burning: Ethernet LEDs should light (link at least), even if T23 is dark (Aurora link not up). Ping would fail if T23 dark (pumps gated) but the LINK LED would be on.

So the answer: 正常——上电后没烧位流，FPGA 不驱动 PHY（复位脚没放开），PHY 与 PC 建立不了链路，网口灯全灭是预期。烧完位流后网口灯（至少链路灯）应该亮——即使 T23 不亮（光链路没通）网口灯也会亮，因为 PHY 链路与 Aurora 无关。

Also give the module/SFP-related note? Not asked. Keep tight.

Also worth mentioning: JTAG programming steps briefly (Hardware Manager) since they'll burn themselves — or offer the script one-liner. Give both concisely.

## 位流路径

```
D:\FPGA\project_9\out\aurora_udp_bridge.bit
```

两种烧法任选：
- **GUI**：Vivado → Open Hardware Manager → Open Target（自动）→ Program Device → 选上面这个 .bit → Program
- **脚本**：`vivado -mode batch -source D:\FPGA\project_9\scripts\program_board.tcl`（成功标志 `PROGRAM_OK`）

## 网口灯不亮——正常

**没烧位流时这就是预期状态**。原因链：

```
上电 → FPGA 空/旧位流已挥发 → 顶层逻辑不在 → eth_rst_n 没被驱动
     → YT8531 PHY 保持复位 → 与 PC 的自协商不会发生 → 链路断 → 网口灯全灭
```

PHY 的链路灯（黄灯）亮不亮只取决于“PHY 与 PC 网卡协商成功与否”，这发生在物理层，与 Aurora/光模块无关。

**烧完位流后的预期灯序**：

| 灯 | 烧完后预期 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 网口黄灯（链路） | **亮**（与 T23 无关） | PHY 出复位 → 与 PC 协商 1Gbps，协商成功就亮 |
| 网口绿灯（活动） | 有流量时闪 | ping 时应闪 |
| T23 | 亮 = 双光链路通；**灭 = 光链路未建立** | 这是 prj9 的关键观测点 |

所以烧完后有个重要的**中间判据**：**网口黄灯亮 + T23 灭** = FPGA/网口侧健康、光链路侧不通（此时查跳线极性/模块）；两个都灭才是更底层的问题（JTAG/位流/供电）。

烧完告诉我两盏灯（网口黄灯、T23）的状态，我再接管跑判据。

VERY interesting failure signature: **2/12 pass, then 10 consecutive timeouts**. ping 20/20 works (ICMP 32B fine!) but UDP: first two lengths (26, 27) echo OK, then everything after L=28 times out.

This is NOT random corruption — it's a "works then stops" pattern. Classic suspects:

1. **The echo FIFO or a path element LATCHES UP / stops after specific frame**: L=28 is the first frame whose... hmm 26,27 pass; 28 fails. What's special about 28? Frame sizes: UDP payload 26 → frame = 26+42 = 68B → in 64b words: 68/8 = 8.5 → 9 words (tkeep used). 27→69B→9 words. 28→70→8.75→9 words. Nothing structurally magic at 28.

2. **A stuck-state bug in the echo path (B side)**: e.g., the FWFT FIFO gets stuck after N words? 26B→(rounded to 64b words by pack: pack emits ceil(68/8)? wait — pack packs BYTES into words: 68 bytes → 8 words full (64B) + 1 partial word with tkeep (4B valid). Total 9 words. 27 payload = 69 bytes → 9 words (8 full + 5B). Both pass. 28 payload = 70B → 9 words (8+6B) — fails?! Weird boundary.

3. **Packet pacing / rate issue**: udp_verify sends sequentially with short gaps; maybe the echo FIFO overflows on back-to-back frames... but L=26,27 passed then ALL subsequent failed — including retries. Once dead, stays dead → something WEDGES. Ping still works though?! Let me re-run ping after the failure to see if the whole path or only UDP died.

Actually — key observation: maybe the wedge happened DURING L=28's frame, and everything after (including larger frames AND the earlier-passing lengths if retried) would fail. The failure is SEQUENTIAL, not length-specific. Test: rerun udp_verify — if now 0/12 (all timeout) but ping still OK → path wedged only for... no, ping uses the same path! ARP+ICMP go through pump→pack→Aurora→B echo→back. If the path wedged, ping would die too.

Test plan:
a) ping now → is the link still alive?
b) rerun udp_verify → still 2/12 pattern or 0/12?

Hypothesis A: **B-side echo FIFO wedges** after some total byte count? 26+27 = 53 bytes through... small.

Hypothesis B: **pack/pump interplay with tkeep on partial words** — the prj8 M2 criterion passed 12/12 with the SAME pack/unpack through GT INTERNAL loopback. The delta in prj9 = real optical + B-side echo FIFO + second Aurora. So the bug is almost surely in the NEW B-side echo (FIFO handling of tvalid/tready/tkeep or the wrapper).

Hypothesis C: Aurora B TX tready stall: when tready deasserts (rate compensation), our shim: b_tx_tvalid=~empty; echo_rd = tvalid & tready. If Aurora asserts tready low for a while and the FIFO fills (512 deep — shouldn't in a burst of 70B)...

Hypothesis D: **srst polarity / safety circuit**: fifo_80b_echo configured with... I set Enable_Safety_Circuit false. srst connected to aurora_rst. aurora_rst = ~sys_rst_n | ~link_ok — stable low after link up. Fine.

Hypothesis E: **the tlast/tkeep fold/unfold bit mapping error** — would corrupt, not wedge.

Hypothesis F: **B Aurora TX stalls forever after receiving a partial word with specific tkeep**? Aurora 64b66b framing requires tkeep only on final word; maybe Aurora B chokes (TX hangs) if a NON-final word has non-full tkeep? Our pack only produces partial on last word. Hmm.

Wait — actually reconsider: ping 20/20 passed BEFORE udp test. Windows ping payload = 32B data → frame 74B → 10 words — LARGER than the failing 28B payload (70B frame)! So frame size isn't the trigger — ping's 74B frames crossed fine (20 of them), but UDP L=28 (70B) dies. Difference between ICMP echo path and UDP echo path: NONE at the bridge level (frames are frames). BUT — timing: udp_verify sends frames back-to-back rapidly (socket send with minimal gap), ping had 1s spacing... no wait, ping default = 1 per second; udp_verify sends 12 packets in rapid succession (~ms apart). Rate-dependent wedge!

REAL SUSPECT — **the classic FWFT AXIS shim bug**: tvalid = ~empty; rd_en = tvalid & tready. Consider last word: FIFO has 1 word, tvalid=1, Aurora tready=1 → rd_en=1 → FIFO empties → NEXT cycle tvalid=0. Fine. BUT during the cycle rd_en pops the LAST word, if Aurora ALSO... fine.

ANOTHER REAL SUSPECT: **tlast/tkeep folding bug at word 9**: L=28 payload = 70B frame = 8 full words + partial word with tkeep=0x3F (6B). The partial word goes through echo FIFO fine (folded in payload)... B's Aurora TX receives a partial tkeep word — legal (final word only). Should be OK.

MOST LIKELY: **Aurora B TX hangs after back-to-back frames without idle**: The B echo path forwards EVERY beat of A's transmission continuously during a burst; Aurora 64b66b framing-mode TX has a requirement to periodically accept CC/idle — it does this by deasserting tready. If our FIFO keeps tvalid=1 continuously, Aurora deasserts tready to insert CC — that's FLOW CONTROL, handled. Unless the Aurora 64b66b core in FRAMING mode has a known errata... 

Hold on — SIMPLER hypothesis: **echo FIFO overflow → echo_wr drops beats silently → B receives a TRUNCATED/CORRUPT frame → but that alone shouldn't wedge**. B's Aurora RX would just get a frame with bad CRC — Aurora framing does its own CRC per frame; bad frame dropped at A's RX... still no wedge.

**WEDGING requires a protocol-level deadlock**. In 64b66b Aurora, a TX-side underrun (tvalid=0 mid-frame?) is ILLEGAL — framing requires tlast-delimited frames with no underrun mid-frame. CAN OUR SHIM UNDERRUN MID-FRAME? tvalid=~empty: if B's RX delivers words with GAPS mid-frame (Aurora RX CAN deassert tvalid mid-frame briefly — e.g., across clock correction!), then B.RX tvalid goes 0 mid-frame... our FIFO drains into Aurora TX faster?? No — FIFO buffers: write side has gaps, read side sees empty → tvalid=0 → **Aurora B TX sees tvalid=0 MID-FRAME → underrun violation → TX state machine WEDGES**! THAT'S IT!

In prj8, the A-side path had: pack → A.TX with pack's own buffering (pack buffers a whole frame and emits continuously — no mid-frame gaps; that was root cause #1 fixed 09-10!). The B-side echo has only a 512-deep FWFT FIFO with NO frame re-shaping: if B.RX tvalid gaps mid-frame (which Aurora RX legitimately does for CC/idle insertion? — actually Aurora 64b66b RX delivers user frames with possible tvalid gaps at word boundaries in some conditions), the FIFO can run EMPTY mid-frame → Aurora B TX underrun mid-frame → wedge until core reset.

Why did ping (20 frames, 1/s) pass but burst UDP die? With slow pings, FIFO likely stayed ahead... actually with gaps in RX mid-frame, ANY frame could underrun — unless RX delivers contiguous beats for small frames. 26/27 passed, 28+ died — cumulative? First underrun happened around the 3rd frame. Plausible.

FIX: B echo must not underrun mid-frame — need frame-reassembly: only start forwarding to Aurora TX when the complete frame is buffered (or track "in-frame" state: once tvalid seen and tlast not yet, don't present... can't un-present). Standard solution: an echo path with FRAME STORE-AND-FORWARD: accumulate until tlast, then stream out. We already HAVE such a module: **axis_word_unpack + axis_word_pack** pair (pack takes bytes and emits whole 64b frames!). Route: B.RX (64b) → unpack (to bytes, in user_clk_b) → **byte FIFO / direct** → pack (bytes→64b whole frames, no mid-frame gap) → B.TX. pack guarantees continuous beats per frame (it was built exactly for the "no mid-frame gaps" property — prj8 root cause #1!).

Simplest: wire B.RX → axis_word_unpack → axis_word_pack → B.TX (both in user_clk_b, pack's output register guarantees continuous frame emission; in-between unpack_en → pack in_data/valid direct wires — pack has its own input FIFO? Let me recall pack's interface: in_data/in_valid byte in, m_tdata/tkeep/tlast/tvalid/tready out, o_frame_cnt/o_overflow. pack buffers a frame internally then bursts out (store-and-forward). unpack: s_tdata/tkeep/tlast/tvalid in, out_data/out_valid bytes. So B: unpack B.RX words→bytes; pack bytes→B.TX words. This reuses PROVEN modules — zero new logic!

Drop the fifo_80b_echo entirely (keep IP unused or remove from create_project — just don't instantiate; harmless to leave IP in project).

Also remove echo shim logic from top; replace with unpack_b/pack_b instances.

Then rebuild + reprogram + retest. Also for debugging BEFORE the fix — should I ILA-capture the wedged state to CONFIRM the hypothesis? Evidence-based debugging is our creed. But the hypothesis is strong and the fix is architecturally clean (reuses proven store-and-forward). A capture now would cost ~10 min; the fix ~30 min incl build. Actually — confirming B.TX wedged vs B channel dropped: if channel_up_b dropped, aurora_rst pulses and the whole thing should have RECOVERED (pumps reset, link renegotiates) — it didn't recover → something latched. T23 status would discriminate: ask user "T23 现在还亮吗?" — if T23 still lit: channels up, echo path wedged (supports TX-underrun-wedge). If dark: channel died and doesn't come back (would implicate loopback/reset... B Aurora in normal mode with link partner A — should renegotiate automatically).

Ask user T23 (cheap, 5 seconds) while I prepare the fix. Actually — do both: ask via text in final message... no, ask_user_question is blocking and fine. But I can also just proceed: the fix (store-and-forward echo) is correct REGARDLESS of which sub-hypothesis holds? If channel_up_b dropped permanently → TX underrun wedge could ALSO cause that (TX violation may wedge the channel state machine → channel_up_b falls → link_ok falls → aurora_rst asserted → pumps reset → but Aurora B core needs... aurora_rst doesn't reset the Aurora COREs (only pumps); core reset = reset_pb/pma_init — static. A wedged Aurora TX would keep channel... hmm channel_up could drop or stay.

The store-and-forward fix addresses the root cause in both scenarios (TX protocol violation). And if B channel died from the violation, fixed echo prevents it.

Decision: implement fix now (unpack_b + pack_b echo replacing raw FIFO), rebuild, reprogram, retest. Note the ILA capture option if fix doesn't hold. Also record the debug trail.

Actually WAIT — one more check before rebuilding: does pack accept input faster than output during frame? pack is store-and-forward with its own buffer (proven in prj8 at 12/12). unpack→pack direct byte wire in same clock domain: unpack emits bytes at ≤1/cycle; pack absorbs (it has internal frame buffer + o_overflow counter if overrun). Good.

Also keep echo_drop counter concept: pack_b's o_overflow replaces it. Debug taps: dbg_pk_b_frames etc.

Edit top:
- Remove: echo_din/dout/full/empty/wr/rd assigns, echo_drop_r block, fifo_80b_echo instance
- Add: wire [7:0] echo_byte; wire echo_byte_en; wire [15:0] echo_b_frames, echo_b_ovf, echo_b_bytes? unpack_b out counters
- u_unpack_b: axis_word_unpack (.clk user_clk_b, .rst aurora_rst, .s_tdata b_rx_tdata, .s_tkeep b_rx_tkeep, .s_tlast b_rx_tlast, .s_tvalid b_rx_tvalid, .out_data echo_byte, .out_valid echo_byte_en, .o_byte_cnt(), .o_frame_cnt(echo_b_rx_frames), .o_overflow(), .o_stall_cnt())
- u_pack_b: axis_word_pack (.clk user_clk_b, .rst aurora_rst, .in_data echo_byte, .in_valid echo_byte_en, .m_tdata b_tx_tdata, .m_tkeep b_tx_tkeep, .m_tlast b_tx_tlast, .m_tvalid b_tx_tvalid, .m_tready b_tx_tready, .o_frame_cnt echo_b_tx_frames, .o_overflow echo_b_ovf)
- debug taps: dbg_b_pk_frames = echo_b_tx_frames, dbg_b_pk_ovf

Rebuild (build only, project exists — pack/unpack modules already in rtl glob ✓). Reprogram. Retest.

ALSO: worth telling user to power-cycle the board before reprogramming? The wedged state is in the live FPGA; new bitstream replaces it entirely — no need to power cycle, programming resets everything. Fine.

Go. First quickly double-check pack/unpack port names from the prj9 rtl files (I know them from top usage — same names ✓ from lines 401-431).

**永久楔死确诊**：UDP 连发后整条回显路径死透（ping 也 0/3），不是长度问题，是**连续流量下路径楔死**。

根因分析（高置信）：B 侧回显用的是裸 FIFO 直通——若 B 的 Aurora RX 在**帧中间**出现 tvalid 间隙（RX 侧合法行为），FIFO 被抽干 → B 的 Aurora TX **帧中欠载（underrun）**→ 违反 64b/66b 帧协议 → TX 状态机楔死。prj8 的 A 侧当年就是靠 pack 的**整帧存储转发**解决同类问题（第一根因）——B 侧我偷懒用了裸 FIFO，把同一课又踩了一遍。

修法：B 回显改为 `unpack→pack` 级联（复用 prj8 验证过的整帧存储转发模块，零新逻辑）。顺手问一句：**现在 T23 还亮吗？**（亮=通道在、数据路径楔；灭=通道也死了——两种都支持此修复，但记录里有用）。先动刀：

But prj8 with the SAME stack did 12/12 + 36/36 through internal loopback... The DELTA between prj8 (working) and prj9 (wedging): loopback 3'b010→3'b000, real optical, B instance with shared QPLL, echo path. AND — the Aurora A core now receives REAL far-end data (its own data echoed), vs internal PMA loopback.

Hmm wait — CRITICAL detail: in prj8 (internal loopback), what A's RX received was EXACTLY synchronized with its TX. In prj9, A receives B's re-transmission with real latency (B's unpack→pack store-and-forward adds frame-time latency). And T22 was lit (sticky rx) initially...

Deterministic frame-count wedge #3... OH WAIT. What about the **A-side pack** (u_pack)? It has o_frame_cnt counter and internal frame buffer. And **pumpA**? The fwd path: stack→pumpA→pack→A.TX. If pack's internal state wedges after 2 frames under some condition... but prj8 ran 36+ frames through the same pack. Delta: in prj9 the READY signal from A.TX — Aurora tready behavior differs in normal mode vs internal-loopback? In internal PMA loopback, TX user clock == RX user clock, everything lockstep. In normal mode, B is a separate core whose TX rate derives from ITS recovered clock (user_clk_b from A's TX light)... B echoes at user_clk_b rate; A receives... A's RX user clock... wait — A's user_clk comes from A's MMCM driven by A's tx_out_clk (TX-derived!). A's RX data comes into A's user_clk domain via the core's internal elastic buffer — with real link, RX rate ≈ B's TX rate ≈ A's TX rate ±ppm — the core handles ppm diff via CC. Fine in theory.

Hmm — but what about **pump_rev read side**: A.RX → unpack → pump_rev write (user_clk) → read (gmii_rx_clk). Wedge candidates upstream of A.TX:
- stack rx side still fine? After wedge, PC sends ping — board receives (ILA1 would show gmii_rx_dv), stack generates ICMP echo (stack_txen fires), pumpA... then echo dies somewhere between pumpA and PC.

I keep guessing. MEASURE NOW. The design has ILA0 (user_clk A-side: tx_tvalid, rx_tvalid, counters!) and ILA1 (eth side: stack_txen, gmii_rx_dv...). What are pack_frames/unpack_frames counters (frozen at 2+icmp?)?

3. arm ILA0 on dbg_tx_tvalid — fires when pack pushes to A.TX
4. ping -n 3
5. upload both, export CSV
6. analyze: stack_txen fired? tx_tvalid fired? counters values?

If tx_tvalid fires (pack still sends into A.TX) but ping times out → wedge downstream of A.TX: Aurora A/B optical or B echo or A.RX→...→pump_rev. If tx_tvalid silent while stack_txen fires → wedge in pumpA/pack (upstream).

23:         puts "ILA0 ARMED on rx_tvalid"
24:     }
25: }

27: after 2000

29:     set cn "?"
30:     catch { set cn [get_property CELL_NAME $ila] }

content.text:
ILA0's probe set: rx_tdata/rx_tkeep/rx_tvalid/rx_tlast, up_frames/up_bytes/up_ovf/up_stall (unpack counters), pk_frames/pk_ovf (pack counters), prev_wr/prev_drop (pump_rev), ch_up/lane_up/hard_err/soft_err. **No dbg_tx_tvalid** — that's why the filter found nothing. But the available set is actually PERFECT for the autopsy:

- **dbg_pk_frames** (pack frame counter): counts frames emitted by u_pack into A.TX. If this counter is FROZEN while stack_txen (ILA1) fires during pings → wedge is at pumpA or pack (upstream of A.TX).
- **dbg_up_frames** (unpack frames from A.RX): counts frames coming BACK through A.RX. If pk_frames advances but up_frames frozen → wedge downstream: A.TX→fiber→B echo→A.RX (B side).
- **dbg_ch_up**: is channel_up still high in the wedged state?
- **dbg_prev_wr/prev_drop**: pump_rev write side (did returning frames reach pump B).

New trigger strategy: trigger ILA0 on **dbg_ch_up eq 1'b0** (channel DOWN) — if it fires, channel dropped! If never fires, channel stayed up and data counters tell the story. But a single capture window with trigger on ch_up=0 may sit forever... Better: TWO-STAGE capture:
1. Arm ILA0 on dbg_rx_tvalid (fires if ANY data returns through A.RX — during wedged pings, if this fires, A.RX is alive!) — wait during wedge pings fail, so rx_tvalid probably silent.
2. More informative: arm ILA0 trigger on **dbg_pk_frames != frozen value** — ILA trigger on VALUE CHANGE: set TRIGGER_COMPARE_VALUE ne2'... hmm ILA value-compare triggers compare against a constant, not "change". For counters, trigger on a specific value is awkward (unknown baseline).

ALTERNATIVE cleaner: trigger ILA0 on **rx_tvalid** (any return data) AND ILA1 on stack_txen; ping; then examine counter VALUES in the captured window (counters are free-running — their absolute value at capture time is the evidence!). Even without a "change" trigger, a 2048-deep window at 151.5MHz = 13.5µs snapshot around ANY trigger... but if rx_tvalid never fires, ILA0 never captures → no counter snapshot!

Use a trigger that ALWAYS fires for ILA0 to get the counter snapshot: trigger on dbg_ch_up eq 1'b1 (fires immediately if channel up — gives us a snapshot window of counters + confirms ch_up). Then read counters in CSV. And ILA1 on stack_txen (fires on stack emission during ping). Both trigger → both CSVs → compare:
- ILA1 CSV: stack_txen pulses during pings → stack alive, pumpA input active. pfwd_wr counter advanced?
- ILA0 CSV: pk_frames value (frozen at N? vs pfwd_wr advanced to M>N?) → localizes the blockage:
  - pfwd_wr advances (frames written into pumpA) but pk_frames frozen → wedge in pumpA read side or pack
  - pk_frames advances but up_frames frozen → wedge downstream (A.TX/B echo/A.RX)
  - up_frames advances but prev_wr frozen → wedge in pump_rev write/unpack output... 
  - ALL frozen + stack_txen firing → wedge before pumpA (stack→pumpA wiring? impossible—prj8 proven)... 

Also grab ch_up value (should be 1 if link up).

Rewrite the capture script: ILA0 trigger dbg_ch_up eq1 (immediate snapshot), ILA1 trigger dbg_stack_txen eq1, catch the ping exec, longer ping (n 5), upload both, save CSVs, THEN analyze counters via PowerShell.

One wrinkle: ILA0 triggering immediately on ch_up=1 means it captures at arm time (before ping) — counters snapshot BEFORE the ping traffic. I need counters AFTER/DURING ping attempts. Sequence: arm ILA1 only → ping 5 → ILA1 captures (stack_txen fired, shows pfwd_wr/pfwd_drop counters AT THAT MOMENT — during the ping attempts ✓) → then arm ILA0 on ch_up → capture counters NOW (after pings) → compare pfwd_wr (from ILA1 window) vs pk_frames/up_frames/prev_wr (from ILA0 window). 

Simpler: two sequential captures in one session:
1. arm ILA1(stack_txen) + ping → ILA1 CSV (eth-domain counters during ping: pfwd_wr advancing? stack alive?)
2. arm ILA0(ch_up=1) → immediate trigger → ILA0 CSV (Aurora-domain counters AFTER pings: pk/up/prev + ch_up)

Then analysis is offline. Rewrite script with catch on ping, two-phase.
ILA0 没挂 `tx_tvalid`，但它挂的**计数器组**正是尸检需要的全链路“计米器”（pk_frames=进A.TX帧数、up_frames=A.RX回来帧数、prev_wr=进泵B帧数、ch_up=链路状态）。改用两阶段抓取：先抓栈侧（ping 期间），再抓 Aurora 侧（ping 之后快照）——计数器差值直接定位楔死段：

content.arguments:
{"code":"const L = [];
L.push("set ltx {D:/FPGA/project_9/scripts/probes.ltx}",
"set out {D:/FPGA/project_9/scripts}",
"open_hw_manager",
"connect_hw_server",
"open_hw_target",
"set dev [lindex [get_hw_devices] 0]",
"current_hw_device $dev",
"catch { set_property PROBES.FILE $ltx $dev }",
"catch { set_property FULL_PROBES.FILE $ltx $dev }",
"refresh_hw_device -update_hw_probes true $dev",
"# ---- 阶段1: 栈侧窗口（ping 期间）----",
"set ila1 [lindex [get_hw_ilas -of_objects $dev -filter {CELL_NAME == u_ila_1}] 0]",
"if {[llength $ila1] == 0} { set ila1 [lindex [get_hw_ilas -of_objects $dev] 1] }",
"set pr [get_hw_probes -of_objects $ila1 -filter {NAME =~ \"*stack_txen*\"}]",
"set_property TRIGGER_COMPARE_VALUE {eq1'b1} $pr",
"run_hw_ila $ila1",
"puts \"PHASE1: ILA1 armed on stack_txen\"",
"catch { exec cmd /c \"ping -n 5 -w 1200 192.168.1.10\" } pout",
"puts \"PHASE1: ping done\"",
"after 2000",
"set d1 [upload_hw_ila_data $ila1]",
"write_hw_ila_data -force -csv_file $out/ila_wedge_phase1.csv $d1",
"puts \"PHASE1: SAVED\"",
"# ---- 阶段2: Aurora 侧快照（ping 之后, 触发于 ch_up——立刻采到计数器现值）----",
"set ila0 [lindex [get_hw_ilas -of_objects $dev -filter {CELL_NAME == u_ila_0}] 0]",
"if {[llength $ila0] == 0} { set ila0 [lindex [get_hw_ilas -of_objects $dev] 0] }",
"set pr0 [get_hw_probes -of_objects $ila0 -filter {NAME =~ \"*ch_up*\"}]",
"if {[llength $pr0] == 0} {",
"    set pr0 [get_hw_probes -of_objects $ila0 -filter {NAME =~ \"*rx_tvalid*\"}]",
"}",
"set_property TRIGGER_COMPARE_VALUE {eq1'b1} $pr0",
"run_hw_ila $ila0",
"puts \"PHASE2: ILA0 armed\"",
"after 3000",
"set d0 [upload_hw_ila_data $ila0]",
"write_hw_ila_data -force -csv_file $out/ila_wedge_phase2.csv $d0",
"puts \"PHASE2: SAVED\"",
"puts \"WEDGE_CAP2_DONE\"");
await tools.write({ file_path: "D:/FPGA/project_9/scripts/ila_cap_wedge.tcl", content: L.join("\n") + "\n" });
console.log("两阶段尸检脚本已写");
const NL = String.fromCharCode(10);
const cmd = [
"cd D:\\FPGA\\project_9",
"& 'D:\\Xilinx\\Vivado\\2023.1\\bin\\vivado.bat' -mode batch -source scripts\\ila_cap_wedge.tcl -notrace > ila_wedge2.log 2>&1",
"Select-String -Path ila_wedge2.log -Pattern 'PHASE|SAVED|WEDGE_CAP2_DONE|ERROR|TRIGGERED' | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() }"
].join(NL);
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: cmd, description: "Run two-phase wedge autopsy", timeoutMs: 300000 });
console.log(r.stdout.text);","description":"Run two-phase counter autopsy capture"}

arguments.content:
set ltx {D:/FPGA/project_9/scripts/probes.ltx}
set out {D:/FPGA/project_9/scripts}
open_hw_manager
connect_hw_server
open_hw_target
set dev [lindex [get_hw_devices] 0]
current_hw_device $dev
catch { set_property PROBES.FILE $ltx $dev }
catch { set_property FULL_PROBES.FILE $ltx $dev }
refresh_hw_device -update_hw_probes true $dev
set ila1 [lindex [get_hw_ilas -of_objects $dev] 1]
set pr [get_hw_probes -of_objects $ila1 -filter {NAME =~ "*gmii_rx_dv*"}]
set_property TRIGGER_COMPARE_VALUE {eq1'b1} $pr
run_hw_ila $ila1
puts "PHASE3: ILA1 armed on gmii_rx_dv"
catch { exec cmd /c "ping -n 4 -w 1200 192.168.1.10" } pout
after 2500
set d [upload_hw_ila_data $ila1]
write_hw_ila_data -force -csv_file $out/ila_wedge_phase3.csv $d
puts "PHASE3: SAVED"
puts "WEDGE_CAP3_DONE"

Takes two required arguments: `code`, the BODY of an async function (erasable syntax only; top-level `await` and `return` work), and `description`, a short summary of what the program does. Call tools as `await tools.name(args)` per the declarations in the system prompt. Only what you print or return is program output — curate it. Image-bearing subtool results are attached after the run.

## Primary Request and Intent
- Overarching goal (from original task): implement the Aurora-UDP data-level bridge per the architecture in `Aurora-UDP数据级桥_汇报_2026-09-04.md`, first-principles (board params only from official examples / verified prj / official XDC; AI docs reference-only), aiming to run it on hardware. **M2 achieved 09-18** (udp_verify 12/12 + 36/36 stress, ping 10/10 & 20/20).

- Then: "你告诉我sfp的ABCD四个口我需要接哪两个；光模块规格确实是10g+" — answered (A=Y11 & B=Y9), dual-cage bitstream built.
- **Current request (verbatim): “总结现有的工程规范，写一版agent.md，然后更新readme”** — write a conventions AGENTS.md and update README.md; this was in progress when compacted.

## Key Technical Concepts
- Kintex UltraScale XCKU060 (xcku060-ffva1156-2-i), Vivado 2023.1 at D:\Xilinx; repo D:\FPGA (git); vault C:\Users\15266\Desktop\毕设 (Obsidian docs).
- prj8 (M2 baseline, frozen): official eth stack + 2× frame_fifo_pump + axis_word_pack/unpack (8↔64b) + Aurora 64b66b 10G X1Y11 loopback 3'b010; rgmii_rx_fix2.v FIXED IDELAY 1250ps (M2 root-cause #3).
- prj9 dual-cage real optical link: loopback 3'b000 both channels; A=Y11=X1Y11 (existing Aurora `aurora_64b66b_0` via new `aurora_64b66b_0_support_ext`), B=Y9=X1Y9 (cloned IP `aurora_64b66b_1` + new `aurora_64b66b_1_support_shared`, no GT_COMMON — one GT_COMMON per quad, shared via _ext outputs: refclk1_out + gt_qpll{clk,refclk,lock,refclklost}; B's qpllreset OR'd into A's common via ext_qpllreset_in).

- Optical cage mapping (locked by official 55_sfp_10g_loop XDC comments + GT LOC evidence): A=Y11=X1Y11(AF12/AF13/AE13), B=Y9=X1Y9(AH12/AG11/AH11), C=Y10=X1Y10, D=Y8=X1Y8; board has 4 SFP+ cages (earlier "one cage" claim was wrong).
- Aurora core interface facts: core's `gt_pll_lock` is an OUTPUT (status); external lock enters via `gt_qplllock_quad1_in`; core takes user_clk/sync_clk as INPUTS from support's CLOCK_MODULE (MMCM per instance); SUPPORT_RESET_LOGIC per instance.

- IBERT constraint: cannot share a GT channel with Aurora (future eye-scan = swap bitstreams or use idle channels C/D).
- Existing repo docs: D:\FPGA\AGENTS.md (133 lines: multi-agent role contract + hardware baseline + STALE status stuck at 09-10), D:\FPGA\README.md (78 lines, mostly current: M2 done, prj9 dual-cage), docs/README.md (doc center naming rules).

MASSIVE finding! Look at phase 3:

- gmii_rx_dv = 72 beats (one frame: 72 bytes = ARP request! preamble 8 + 64-byte ARP frame... ARP frame = 60B + FCS 4 = 64, +8 preamble = 72 ✓)
- **The frame is an ARP REQUEST** (bytes: ...08 06 (ethertype ARP) 00 01 08 00 06 04 00 01 = htype/ptype/hlen/plen/op=1 request) — **the PC is RE-ARPING because its ARP entry went stale/failed!** (After ~20s of failed pings, Windows re-resolves ARP.)
- The frame bytes are **CLEAN**: preamble 55×7+d5, dst broadcast ff×6, src 08:3c:03:a0:26:96 (PC NIC MAC), ethertype 0806, ARP payload correct, FCS tail present.
- **stack_txen = 72 beats — THE STACK IS EMITTING A FRAME** (the ARP reply generation is running!)
- icmp_rec_done=0 (no ICMP arriving — because PC is at ARP stage, not ICMP yet... actually ping would ICMP only after ARP resolves; ARP never resolves because... the stack EMITS the reply (txen=72) but the reply never reaches the PC!)

So REVISED picture: the RX ingress is FINE (clean ARP request received, parsed). The stack STARTS emitting an ARP reply (stack_txen=72 beats = 72 bytes = a full frame being pushed out). **The TX direction (stack→pumpA→pack→A.TX→fiber→B→back→pump_rev→RGMII TX→PC) is dead in the WEDGED state** — the reply gets generated but never arrives.

But phase 2 said pk_frames=25 — pack emitted 25 frames historically. Question: did pk_frames ADVANCE during phase 3's ARP-reply generation? If the stack emitted (txen=72) but pfwd_wr/pk_frames didn't advance → **the wedge is between stack_txen and pumpA write** — i.e., in the PUMP A path (stack gmii bytes → pumpA). The pump! pumpA read side drains into pack (aurora domain); write side takes stack bytes (gmii_rx_clk 125M domain). If pumpA's read side STALLED (pack not ready / Aurora tready stuck?), the FIFO fills → full → pfwd_drop counts... but prev_drop=0 is pump_rev's. pumpA's drop = pfwd_drop! Check pfwd_drop in phase3 CSV and pfwd_wr advancement.

Wait — phase2 evidence again: pk=up=prev_wr=25 ALL EQUAL — so through-frame 25 everything balanced. Frame 26 (L=28 UDP? or the ARP now) entered stack emission but never became pk_frame #26. Where did it stop? Candidates between stack_txen and A.TX:
1. pumpA write (gmii domain): pfwd_wr counter (phase1/3 CSV has it!)
2. pumpA read → pack input (user domain): pack's in_valid acceptance
3. pack → A.TX: A.TX tready stuck?! **AURORA A TX WEDGE** — the TX-side underrun/protocol violation... wait — on the A side, pack guarantees gapless per-frame output, and prj8 ran the same. BUT — prj8 had LOOPBACK (3'b010) where TX feed = internal; prj9 has REAL link — A.TX tready behavior: in normal mode, Aurora asserts tready periodically for CC. If A.TX tready went LOW and STAYED low (TX state machine stuck — e.g., because of something on RX side?), pack stalls, pumpA fills, drops start.

Check phase3 CSV columns: pfwd_wr, pfwd_drop FIRST vs LAST in window + stack_txen pulses. If pfwd_wr doesn't advance during the 72-byte emission AND pfwd_drop increments → pumpA full → downstream stall (pack/A.TX). 

And ILA0 (Aurora domain) probe list doesn't include A.TX tready or pack input signals... but dbg_pk_frames (pack OUTPUT frame count) history: phase2 took snapshot AFTER wedge. If I re-trigger ILA0 NOW (after phase3's ARP emission attempt) and pk_frames is STILL 25 while pfwd_wr advanced by 1 → stall between pumpA-read and pack-output. Combined with phase2's balanced 25/25/25 → the stall segment = pumpA read / pack / A.TX. 

Hmm wait — actually there's ANOTHER candidate I overlooked: **pack's in_valid→acceptance**: pack accepts bytes into its frame buffer; if pack's INPUT side (byte FIFO within pack) is FULL because its OUTPUT side never drains (A.TX tready stuck), same story: stall at A.TX.

KEY QUESTION: is A.TX tready stuck low? No probe for it... BUT I can infer: if A.TX tready stuck → pack stalls → pk_frames frozen. If instead pumpA read side stuck (its own bug) → pack idle. Distinguish via... hmm, ILA0 has dbg_rx_tvalid/rx_tdata (A.RX side) + counters only. No TX-side signal probes on ILA0. 

INFERENCE ROUTE: up_frames=25 = A.RX still balanced — meaning B keeps echoing what A sends; B's echo implies B receives OUR frames... if A.TX were wedged, nothing flows → consistent.

ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS — **pumpA itself wedged**: its read-side enable logic has a known-bad corner: pump read drains when ~rd_empty & downstream ready... if downstream (pack in_ready?) — pack has no in_ready (pack input: in_data/in_valid, internally drops if buffer full via o_overflow!). **PACK OVERFLOW!** pack's o_overflow counts dropped frames when its internal buffer overflows! dbg_pk_ovf is ON ILA0! Check phase2 CSV: dbg_pk_ovf value! If pk_ovf > 0 → pack DROPPED frames on input overflow — which happens if pack can't DRAIN (A.TX tready stuck) while stack keeps feeding.

Wait no — pumpA sits between stack and pack: stack → pumpA (async FIFO) → pack. Pack input receives pumpA's READ side at user_clk — pumpA read enable = pack's in_valid? The pump read logic (from prj8 design): pump asserts out_valid=~rd_empty & downstream_accepts... pack's input protocol: in_valid presented, pack samples unconditionally (no ready!) and counts overflow if buffer full mid-frame. block.text:
MASSIVE finding! Look at phase 3:

- gmii_rx_dv = 72 beats (one frame: 72 bytes = ARP request! preamble 8 + 64-byte ARP frame... ARP frame = 60B + FCS 4 = 64, +8 preamble = 72 ✓)
- **The frame is an ARP REQUEST** (bytes: ...08 06 (ethertype ARP) 00 01 08 00 06 04 00 01 = htype/ptype/hlen/plen/op=1 request) — **the PC is RE-ARPING because its ARP entry went stale/failed!** (After ~20s of failed pings, Windows re-resolves ARP.)
- The frame bytes are **CLEAN**: preamble 55×7+d5, dst broadcast ff×6, src 08:3c:03:a0:26:96 (PC NIC MAC), ethertype 0806, ARP payload correct, FCS tail present.
- **stack_txen = 72 beats — THE STACK IS EMITTING A FRAME** (the ARP reply generation is running!)
- icmp_rec_done=0 (no ICMP arriving — because PC is at ARP stage, not ICMP yet... actually ping would ICMP only after ARP resolves; ARP never resolves because... the stack EMITS the reply (txen=72) but the reply never reaches the PC!)

So REVISED picture: the RX ingress is FINE (clean ARP request received, parsed). The stack STARTS emitting an ARP reply (stack_txen=72 beats = 72 bytes = a full frame being pushed out). **The TX direction (stack→pumpA→pack→A.TX→fiber→B→back→pump_rev→RGMII TX→PC) is dead in the WEDGED state** — the reply gets generated but never arrives.

But phase 2 said pk_frames=25 — pack emitted 25 frames historically. Question: did pk_frames ADVANCE during phase 3's ARP-reply generation? If the stack emitted (txen=72) but pfwd_wr/pk_frames didn't advance → **the wedge is between stack_txen and pumpA write** — i.e., in the PUMP A path (stack gmii bytes → pumpA). The pump! pumpA read side drains into pack (aurora domain); write side takes stack bytes (gmii_rx_clk 125M domain). If pumpA's read side STALLED (pack not ready / Aurora tready stuck?), the FIFO fills → full → pfwd_drop counts... but prev_drop=0 is pump_rev's. pumpA's drop = pfwd_drop! Check pfwd_drop in phase3 CSV and pfwd_wr advancement.

Wait — phase2 evidence again: pk=up=prev_wr=25 ALL EQUAL — so through-frame 25 everything balanced. Frame 26 (L=28 UDP? or the ARP now) entered stack emission but never became pk_frame #26. Where did it stop? Candidates between stack_txen and A.TX:
1. pumpA write (gmii domain): pfwd_wr counter (phase1/3 CSV has it!)
2. pumpA read → pack input (user domain): pack's in_valid acceptance
3. pack → A.TX: A.TX tready stuck?! **AURORA A TX WEDGE** — the TX-side underrun/protocol violation... wait — on the A side, pack guarantees gapless per-frame output, and prj8 ran the same. BUT — prj8 had LOOPBACK (3'b010) where TX feed = internal; prj9 has REAL link — A.TX tready behavior: in normal mode, Aurora asserts tready periodically for CC. If A.TX tready went LOW and STAYED low (TX state machine stuck — e.g., because of something on RX side?), pack stalls, pumpA fills, drops start.

Check phase3 CSV columns: pfwd_wr, pfwd_drop FIRST vs LAST in window + stack_txen pulses. If pfwd_wr doesn't advance during the 72-byte emission AND pfwd_drop increments → pumpA full → downstream stall (pack/A.TX). 

And ILA0 (Aurora domain) probe list doesn't include A.TX tready or pack input signals... but dbg_pk_frames (pack OUTPUT frame count) history: phase2 took snapshot AFTER wedge. If I re-trigger ILA0 NOW (after phase3's ARP emission attempt) and pk_frames is STILL 25 while pfwd_wr advanced by 1 → stall between pumpA-read and pack-output. Combined with phase2's balanced 25/25/25 → the stall segment = pumpA read / pack / A.TX. 

Hmm wait — actually there's ANOTHER candidate I overlooked: **pack's in_valid→acceptance**: pack accepts bytes into its frame buffer; if pack's INPUT side (byte FIFO within pack) is FULL because its OUTPUT side never drains (A.TX tready stuck), same story: stall at A.TX.

KEY QUESTION: is A.TX tready stuck low? No probe for it... BUT I can infer: if A.TX tready stuck → pack stalls → pk_frames frozen. If instead pumpA read side stuck (its own bug) → pack idle. Distinguish via... hmm, ILA0 has dbg_rx_tvalid/rx_tdata (A.RX side) + counters only. No TX-side signal probes on ILA0. 

INFERENCE ROUTE: up_frames=25 = A.RX still balanced — meaning B keeps echoing what A sends; B's echo implies B receives OUR frames... if A.TX were wedged, nothing flows → consistent.

ALTERNATIVE HYPOTHESIS — **pumpA itself wedged**: its read-side enable logic has a known-bad corner: pump read drains when ~rd_empty & downstream ready... if downstream (pack in_ready?) — pack has no in_ready (pack input: in_data/in_valid, internally drops if buffer full via o_overflow!). **PACK OVERFLOW!** pack's o_overflow counts dropped frames when its internal buffer overflows! dbg_pk_ovf is ON ILA0! Check phase2 CSV: dbg_pk_ovf value! If pk_ovf > 0 → pack DROPPED frames on input overflow — which happens if pack can't DRAIN (A.TX tready stuck) while stack keeps feeding.

Wait no — pumpA sits between stack and pack: stack → pumpA (async FIFO) → pack. Pack input receives pumpA's READ side at user_clk — pumpA read enable = pack's in_valid? The pump read logic (from prj8 design): pump asserts out_valid=~rd_empty & downstream_accepts... pack's input protocol: in_valid presented, pack samples unconditionally (no ready!) and counts overflow if buffer full mid-frame. So if pack buffer full (because output stalled by A.TX tready), pumpA keeps pumping bytes in → pack overflows → **mid-frame bytes lost → pack drops the frame (ovf++)** → AND — here's the killer — if pack's internal frame pointer state gets corrupted by mid-frame overflow, it might wedge itself!
