1: //=============================================================================
2: // frame_fifo_pump.v — frame-aware CDC pump (self-contained, no IP)
3: // Purpose : cross a GMII frame stream from clock domain A (RGMII PHY eth_rxc)
4: //           to domain B (PCS/PMA userclk2) with FRAME integrity: buffer one
5: //           full frame, then drain it gaplessly into the PCS TX.
6: // Policy  : handshake-gated — frames arriving while the previous frame is in
7: //           flight are DROPPED (wr_drop_cnt). Human-paced UDP/ARP/ping traffic
8: //           has huge gaps; stress mode is future work.
9: // CDC     : Cummings-style async FIFO — gray pointers, 2FF sync both ways.
10: //=============================================================================
11: module frame_fifo_pump(
12:     // write side = source frame stream (domain A)
13:     input               wr_clk      ,
14:     input               wr_rst_n    ,
15:     input       [7:0]   wr_data     ,   // GMII byte stream (preamble..CRC)
16:     input               wr_en       ,   // frame data valid
17:     // read side = PCS/PMA GMII TX (domain B)
18:     input               rd_clk      ,
19:     input               rd_rst_n    ,
20:     output  reg [7:0]   rd_data     ,   // byte out (aligned with rd_en)
21:     output  reg         rd_en       ,   // frame valid out
22:     // status (for ILA / debug)
23:     output  reg [15:0]  wr_frame_cnt,
24:     output  reg [15:0]  wr_drop_cnt ,
25:     output  reg [15:0]  rd_frame_cnt
26: );
27: 
28: //=============================================================================
29: // declarations (all up front — no use-before-declare)
30: //=============================================================================
31: localparam AW = 11;
32: localparam S_IDLE = 1'b0, S_PUMP = 1'b1;
33: 
34: reg [7:0]  ram [0:(1<<AW)-1];
35: 
36: reg  [AW:0] wr_bin;                     // write pointer (binary, domain A)
37: reg  [AW:0] rd_bin;                     // read pointer (binary, domain B)
38: reg  [AW:0] wr_ptr_g, rd_ptr_g;         // gray pointers
39: reg  [AW:0] rd_ptr_g_s1, rd_ptr_g_s2;   // rd gray synced into wr domain
40: reg  [AW:0] wr_ptr_g_s1, wr_ptr_g_s2;   // wr gray synced into rd domain
41: 
42: reg             hs_busy;                // frame in flight (handshake pending)
43: reg             wr_dv_d;                // wr_en delayed (frame-end detect)
44: reg [15:0]      wr_cnt;                 // bytes written in current frame
45: reg [15:0]      frame_len_mb;           // mailbox: latched frame length
46: reg             wr_done_t;              // toggle: frame available (crossing)
47: reg             rd_done_t;              // toggle: frame consumed (crossing)
48: reg             rd_done_t_s1, rd_done_t_s2; // rd_done sync into wr domain
49: reg             rd_done_t_ack;            // last acked toggle state (wr domain)
50: reg             wr_done_t_s1, wr_done_t_s2; // wr_done sync into rd domain
51: 
52: wire            wr_valid;               // write strobe (data + pointer advance)
53: wire [AW:0]     wr_bin_next;
54: wire            wr_full;
55: wire            wr_en_fall;             // frame end detect (write domain)
56: 
57: reg  [15:0]     rd_cnt_i;               // reads issued
58: reg  [15:0]     rd_cnt_o;               // bytes presented on output
59: reg  [15:0]     rd_len;                 // latched frame length
60: reg             rd_en_i;                // FIFO read strobe
61: reg             st;                     // pump FSM state
62: reg             ram_dout_v;             // ram_dout valid flag
63: reg  [7:0]      ram_dout;
64: 
65: wire [AW:0]     rd_bin_next;
66: wire            rd_empty;
67: 
68: function [AW:0] bin2gray(input [AW:0] b);
69:     bin2gray = (b >> 1) ^ b;
70: endfunction
71: 
72: //=============================================================================
73: // write side: pointers (advance ONLY on actual writes) + frame gather
74: //=============================================================================
75: assign wr_bin_next = wr_bin + 1'b1;
76: assign wr_full = (wr_bin_next[AW] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW]) &&
77:                  (wr_bin_next[AW-1] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW-1]);
78: assign wr_valid = wr_en && !wr_full;
79: assign wr_en_fall = ~wr_en & wr_dv_d;
80: 
81: always @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
82:     if(!wr_rst_n) begin
83:         wr_bin <= 0; wr_ptr_g <= 0;
84:         rd_ptr_g_s1 <= 0; rd_ptr_g_s2 <= 0;
85:     end
86:     else begin
87:         rd_ptr_g_s1 <= rd_ptr_g;
88:         rd_ptr_g_s2 <= rd_ptr_g_s1;
89:         if(wr_valid) begin
90:             wr_bin   <= wr_bin_next;
91:             wr_ptr_g <= bin2gray(wr_bin_next);
92:         end
93:     end
94: end
95: 
96: always @(posedge wr_clk) begin
97:     if(wr_valid)
98:         ram[wr_bin[AW-1:0]] <= wr_data;
99: end
100: 
101: // frame gather + 4-phase handshake（含释放逻辑，单块单驱动——C18 根治）
102: always @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
103:     if(!wr_rst_n) begin
104:         hs_busy <= 1'b0; wr_dv_d <= 1'b0; wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
105:         frame_len_mb <= 16'd0; wr_done_t <= 1'b0;
106:         wr_frame_cnt <= 16'd0; wr_drop_cnt <= 16'd0;
107:         rd_done_t_s1 <= 1'b0; rd_done_t_s2 <= 1'b0; rd_done_t_ack <= 1'b0;
108:     end
109:     else begin
110:         wr_dv_d <= wr_en;
111:         rd_done_t_s1  <= rd_done_t;
112:         rd_done_t_s2  <= rd_done_t_s1;
113:         rd_done_t_ack <= rd_done_t_s2;
114:         // C20 修复(2026-09-10): wr_cnt 必须在两个分支都累加。
115:         // 原实现只在 !hs_busy 分支累加，而 hs_busy 拉高的同一拍已把 wr_cnt 清零，
116:         // 于是 busy 期间 wr_en_fall 时 wr_cnt 恒为 0 → 丢帧分支永不成立 →
117:         // wr_drop_cnt 成了死计数器("drop=0" 不能证明没丢帧)。
118:         if(wr_valid)
119:             wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 16'd1;
120:         if(!hs_busy) begin
121:             if(wr_en_fall && wr_cnt != 16'd0) begin
122:                 frame_len_mb <= wr_cnt;
123:                 wr_done_t    <= ~wr_done_t;     // frame available -> toggle
124:                 hs_busy      <= 1'b1;
125:                 wr_frame_cnt <= wr_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
126:             end
127:             if(wr_en_fall)
128:                 wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
129:         end
130:         else begin
131:             // handshake pending: incoming frames dropped (counted)
132:             if(wr_en_fall && wr_cnt != 16'd0) begin
133:                 wr_drop_cnt <= wr_drop_cnt + 16'd1;
134:                 wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
135:             end
136:             if(rd_done_t_s2 != rd_done_t_ack)
137:                 hs_busy <= 1'b0;                // frame fully drained -> release
138:         end
139:     end
140: end
141: 
142: //=============================================================================
143: // read side: pointers (advance ONLY on actual reads) + pump FSM
144: //=============================================================================
145: assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + 1'b1;
146: // C21 修复(2026-09-17): rd_empty 必须用当前 rd_bin，不能用 rd_bin_next。
147: //   原式 (bin2gray(rd_bin_next)==wr_ptr_g_s2) 是"提前一拍判空"：当读指针追到
148: //   与写指针持平（rd_bin=末字节地址）时，rd_bin_next 已等于 wr_ptr，于是把
149: //   **每帧最后一字节**误判为空而拒读（板上实测：第二帧恒少 1 字节、rd_frame_cnt
150: //   停在 1、FSM 永久卡死）。本泵是"整帧先写满再读"，读期间写指针稳定，
151: //   用 rd_bin 判空安全：rd_bin 追上 wr_ptr 才为空，末字节允许读出。
152: assign rd_empty = (bin2gray(rd_bin) == wr_ptr_g_s2);
153: 
154: always @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
155:     if(!rd_rst_n) begin
156:         rd_bin <= 0; rd_ptr_g <= 0;
157:         wr_ptr_g_s1 <= 0; wr_ptr_g_s2 <= 0;
158:     end
159:     else begin
160:         wr_ptr_g_s1 <= wr_ptr_g;
161:         wr_ptr_g_s2 <= wr_ptr_g_s1;
162:         if(rd_en_i && !rd_empty) begin
163:             rd_bin   <= rd_bin_next;
164:             rd_ptr_g <= bin2gray(rd_bin_next);
165:         end
166:     end
167: end
168: 
169: // FIFO read data capture (registered, 1-cycle latency, strobed)
170: always @(posedge rd_clk) begin
171:     if(rd_en_i && !rd_empty)
172:         ram_dout <= ram[rd_bin[AW-1:0]];
173: end
174: 
175: always @(posedge rd_clk) begin
176:     ram_dout_v <= rd_en_i && !rd_empty;
177: end
178: 
179: // pump FSM: issue exactly rd_len reads, present exactly rd_len gapless bytes
180: always @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
181:     if(!rd_rst_n) begin
182:         st <= S_IDLE; rd_cnt_i <= 16'd0; rd_cnt_o <= 16'd0; rd_len <= 16'd0;
183:         rd_en_i <= 1'b0;
184:         rd_data <= 8'd0; rd_en <= 1'b0;
185:         rd_frame_cnt <= 16'd0; rd_done_t <= 1'b0;
186:         wr_done_t_s1 <= 1'b0; wr_done_t_s2 <= 1'b0;
187:         // NOTE: ram_dout/ram_dout_v 故意不在本块复位——由上方无复位捕获块唯一驱动
188:         // （在此赋值 = 双时钟风格多驱动 → MDRV/GND 折叠，坑位 C17）
189:     end
190:     else begin
191:         wr_done_t_s1 <= wr_done_t;
192:         wr_done_t_s2 <= wr_done_t_s1;
193: 
194:         case(st)
195:             S_IDLE: begin
196:                 rd_en <= 1'b0;
197:                 if(wr_done_t_s1 != wr_done_t_s2) begin   // new frame available
198:                     rd_len   <= frame_len_mb;            // mailbox stable (4-phase)
199:                     rd_cnt_i <= 16'd0;
200:                     rd_cnt_o <= 16'd0;
201:                     rd_en_i  <= 1'b1;                    // prime first read
202:                     st       <= S_PUMP;
203:                 end
204:             end
205:             S_PUMP: begin
206:                 // output pipeline: (ram_dout, ram_dout_v) -> (rd_data, rd_en)
207:                 rd_data <= ram_dout;
208:                 rd_en   <= ram_dout_v;
209:                 if(rd_en) begin                          // byte presented this cycle
210:                     rd_cnt_o <= rd_cnt_o + 16'd1;
211:                     if(rd_cnt_o == rd_len - 16'd1) begin // last byte out now
212:                         st           <= S_IDLE;
213:                         rd_en        <= 1'b0;            // stop after this cycle
214:                         rd_frame_cnt <= rd_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
215:                         rd_done_t    <= ~rd_done_t;      // ack -> release wr side
216:                     end
217:                 end
218:                 // read issuing: exactly rd_len strobes
219:                 if(rd_cnt_i < rd_len - 16'd1)
220:                     rd_en_i <= 1'b1;
221:                 else
222:                     rd_en_i <= 1'b0;
223:                 if(rd_en_i)
224:                     rd_cnt_i <= rd_cnt_i + 16'd1;
225:             end
226:         endcase
227:     end
228: end
229: 
230: endmodule

18:     input               rd_clk      ,
19:     input               rd_rst_n    ,
20:     output  reg [7:0]   rd_data     ,   // byte out (aligned with rd_en)
21:     output  reg         rd_en       ,   // frame valid out
22:     // status (for ILA / debug)
23:     output  reg [15:0]  wr_frame_cnt,
24:     output  reg [15:0]  wr_drop_cnt ,
25:     output  reg [15:0]  rd_frame_cnt
26: );
27: 
28: //=============================================================================
29: // declarations (all up front — no use-before-declare)
30: //=============================================================================
31: localparam AW = 11;
32: localparam S_IDLE = 1'b0, S_PUMP = 1'b1;
33: 
34: reg [7:0]  ram [0:(1<<AW)-1];
35: 
36: reg  [AW:0] wr_bin;                     // write pointer (binary, domain A)
37: reg  [AW:0] rd_bin;                     // read pointer (binary, domain B)
38: reg  [AW:0] wr_ptr_g, rd_ptr_g;         // gray pointers
39: reg  [AW:0] rd_ptr_g_s1, rd_ptr_g_s2;   // rd gray synced into wr domain
40: reg  [AW:0] wr_ptr_g_s1, wr_ptr_g_s2;   // wr gray synced into rd domain
41: 
42: reg             hs_busy;                // frame in flight (handshake pending)
43: reg             wr_dv_d;                // wr_en delayed (frame-end detect)
44: reg [15:0]      wr_cnt;                 // bytes written in current frame
45: reg [15:0]      frame_len_mb;           // mailbox: latched frame length
46: reg             wr_done_t;              // toggle: frame available (crossing)
47: reg             rd_done_t;              // toggle: frame consumed (crossing)
48: reg             rd_done_t_s1, rd_done_t_s2; // rd_done sync into wr domain
49: reg             rd_done_t_ack;            // last acked toggle state (wr domain)
50: reg             wr_done_t_s1, wr_done_t_s2; // wr_done sync into rd domain
51: 
52: wire            wr_valid;               // write strobe (data + pointer advance)
53: wire [AW:0]     wr_bin_next;
54: wire            wr_full;
55: wire            wr_en_fall;             // frame end detect (write domain)
56: 
57: reg  [15:0]     rd_cnt_i;               // reads issued
58: reg  [15:0]     rd_cnt_o;               // bytes presented on output
59: reg  [15:0]     rd_len;                 // latched frame length
60: reg             rd_en_i;                // FIFO read strobe
61: reg             st;                     // pump FSM state
62: reg             ram_dout_v;             // ram_dout valid flag
63: reg  [7:0]      ram_dout;
64: 
65: wire [AW:0]     rd_bin_next;
66: wire            rd_empty;
67: 
68: function [AW:0] bin2gray(input [AW:0] b);
69:     bin2gray = (b >> 1) ^ b;
70: endfunction
71: 
72: //=============================================================================
73: // write side: pointers (advance ONLY on actual writes) + frame gather
74: //=============================================================================
75: assign wr_bin_next = wr_bin + 1'b1;
76: assign wr_full = (wr_bin_next[AW] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW]) &&
77:                  (wr_bin_next[AW-1] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW-1]);
78: assign wr_valid = wr_en && !wr_full;
79: assign wr_en_fall = ~wr_en & wr_dv_d;
80: 
81: always @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
82:     if(!wr_rst_n) begin
83:         wr_bin <= 0; wr_ptr_g <= 0;
84:         rd_ptr_g_s1 <= 0; rd_ptr_g_s2 <= 0;
85:     end
86:     else begin
87:         rd_ptr_g_s1 <= rd_ptr_g;
88:         rd_ptr_g_s2 <= rd_ptr_g_s1;
89:         if(wr_valid) begin
90:             wr_bin   <= wr_bin_next;
91:             wr_ptr_g <= bin2gray(wr_bin_next);
92:         end
93:     end
94: end
95: 
96: always @(posedge wr_clk) begin
97:     if(wr_valid)
98:         ram[wr_bin[AW-1:0]] <= wr_data;
99: end
100: 
101: // frame gather + 4-phase handshake（含释放逻辑，单块单驱动——C18 根治）
102: always @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
103:     if(!wr_rst_n) begin
104:         hs_busy <= 1'b0; wr_dv_d <= 1'b0; wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
105:         frame_len_mb <= 16'd0; wr_done_t <= 1'b0;
106:         wr_frame_cnt <= 16'd0; wr_drop_cnt <= 16'd0;
107:         rd_done_t_s1 <= 1'b0; rd_done_t_s2 <= 1'b0; rd_done_t_ack <= 1'b0;
108:     end
109:     else begin
110:         wr_dv_d <= wr_en;
111:         rd_done_t_s1  <= rd_done_t;
112:         rd_done_t_s2  <= rd_done_t_s1;
113:         rd_done_t_ack <= rd_done_t_s2;
114:         // C20 修复(2026-09-10): wr_cnt 必须在两个分支都累加。
115:         // 原实现只在 !hs_busy 分支累加，而 hs_busy 拉高的同一拍已把 wr_cnt 清零，
116:         // 于是 busy 期间 wr_en_fall 时 wr_cnt 恒为 0 → 丢帧分支永不成立 →
117:         // wr_drop_cnt 成了死计数器("drop=0" 不能证明没丢帧)。
118:         if(wr_valid)
119:             wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 16'd1;
120:         if(!hs_busy) begin
121:             if(wr_en_fall && wr_cnt != 16'd0) begin
122:                 frame_len_mb <= wr_cnt;
123:                 wr_done_t    <= ~wr_done_t;     // frame available -> toggle
124:                 hs_busy      <= 1'b1;
125:                 wr_frame_cnt <= wr_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
126:             end
127:             if(wr_en_fall)
128:                 wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
129:         end
130:         else begin
131:             // handshake pending: incoming frames dropped (counted)
132:             if(wr_en_fall && wr_cnt != 16'd0) begin
133:                 wr_drop_cnt <= wr_drop_cnt + 16'd1;
134:                 wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
135:             end
136:             if(rd_done_t_s2 != rd_done_t_ack)
137:                 hs_busy <= 1'b0;                // frame fully drained -> release
138:         end
139:     end
140: end
141: 
142: //=============================================================================
143: // read side: pointers (advance ONLY on actual reads) + pump FSM
144: //=============================================================================
145: assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + 1'b1;
146: // C21 修复(2026-09-17): rd_empty 必须用当前 rd_bin，不能用 rd_bin_next。
147: //   原式 (bin2gray(rd_bin_next)==wr_ptr_g_s2) 是"提前一拍判空"：当读指针追到
148: //   与写指针持平（rd_bin=末字节地址）时，rd_bin_next 已等于 wr_ptr，于是把
149: //   **每帧最后一字节**误判为空而拒读（板上实测：第二帧恒少 1 字节、rd_frame_cnt
150: //   停在 1、FSM 永久卡死）。本泵是"整帧先写满再读"，读期间写指针稳定，
151: //   用 rd_bin 判空安全：rd_bin 追上 wr_ptr 才为空，末字节允许读出。
152: assign rd_empty = (bin2gray(rd_bin) == wr_ptr_g_s2);
153: 
154: always @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
155:     if(!rd_rst_n) begin
156:         rd_bin <= 0; rd_ptr_g <= 0;
157:         wr_ptr_g_s1 <= 0; wr_ptr_g_s2 <= 0;
158:     end
159:     else begin
160:         wr_ptr_g_s1 <= wr_ptr_g;
161:         wr_ptr_g_s2 <= wr_ptr_g_s1;
162:         if(rd_en_i && !rd_empty) begin
163:             rd_bin   <= rd_bin_next;
164:             rd_ptr_g <= bin2gray(rd_bin_next);
165:         end
166:     end
167: end
168: 
169: // FIFO read data capture (registered, 1-cycle latency, strobed)
170: always @(posedge rd_clk) begin
171:     if(rd_en_i && !rd_empty)
172:         ram_dout <= ram[rd_bin[AW-1:0]];
173: end
174: 
175: always @(posedge rd_clk) begin
176:     ram_dout_v <= rd_en_i && !rd_empty;
177: end
178: 
179: // pump FSM: issue exactly rd_len reads, present exactly rd_len gapless bytes
180: always @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
181:     if(!rd_rst_n) begin
182:         st <= S_IDLE; rd_cnt_i <= 16'd0; rd_cnt_o <= 16'd0; rd_len <= 16'd0;
183:         rd_en_i <= 1'b0;
184:         rd_data <= 8'd0; rd_en <= 1'b0;
185:         rd_frame_cnt <= 16'd0; rd_done_t <= 1'b0;
186:         wr_done_t_s1 <= 1'b0; wr_done_t_s2 <= 1'b0;
187:         // NOTE: ram_dout/ram_dout_v 故意不在本块复位——由上方无复位捕获块唯一驱动
188:         // （在此赋值 = 双时钟风格多驱动 → MDRV/GND 折叠，坑位 C17）
189:     end
190:     else begin
191:         wr_done_t_s1 <= wr_done_t;
192:         wr_done_t_s2 <= wr_done_t_s1;
193: 
194:         case(st)
195:             S_IDLE: begin
196:                 rd_en <= 1'b0;
197:                 if(wr_done_t_s1 != wr_done_t_s2) begin   // new frame available
198:                     rd_len   <= frame_len_mb;            // mailbox stable (4-phase)
199:                     rd_cnt_i <= 16'd0;
200:                     rd_cnt_o <= 16'd0;
201:                     rd_en_i  <= 1'b1;                    // prime first read
202:                     st       <= S_PUMP;
203:                 end
204:             end
205:             S_PUMP: begin
206:                 // output pipeline: (ram_dout, ram_dout_v) -> (rd_data, rd_en)
207:                 rd_data <= ram_dout;
208:                 rd_en   <= ram_dout_v;
209:                 if(rd_en) begin                          // byte presented this cycle
210:                     rd_cnt_o <= rd_cnt_o + 16'd1;
211:                     if(rd_cnt_o == rd_len - 16'd1) begin // last byte out now
212:                         st           <= S_IDLE;
213:                         rd_en        <= 1'b0;            // stop after this cycle
214:                         rd_frame_cnt <= rd_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
215:                         rd_done_t    <= ~rd_done_t;      // ack -> release wr side
216:                     end
217:                 end
218:                 // read issuing: exactly rd_len strobes
219:                 if(rd_cnt_i < rd_len - 16'd1)
220:                     rd_en_i <= 1'b1;
221:                 else
222:                     rd_en_i <= 1'b0;
223:                 if(rd_en_i)
224:                     rd_cnt_i <= rd_cnt_i + 16'd1;
225:             end
226:         endcase
227:     end
228: end
229: 
230: endmodule

2: // aurora_udp_bridge.v — Aurora-UDP 数据级桥顶层（project_9 双笼版：A(Y11,X1Y11)↔B(Y9,X1Y9) 真光链路）
3: //
4: // 数据流（数据级 64b/66b 验证）:
5: //   PC --RJ45(GE1,RGMII)--> [以太网栈] --回显帧--> 帧泵(CDC) --> 打包(8→64)
6: //      --> Aurora 64b/66b TX --> SFP+ 真光链路(loopback=3'b000) --> Aurora RX
7: //      --> 解包(64→8) --> 帧泵(CDC) --> RGMII TX --> PC
8: //
9: // 判据: PC 脚本比对回显 payload == 发送 payload（数据必穿过 64b/66b 编解码才回得来）
10: //
11: // 关键设计:
12: //   - Aurora 仅插在「栈 TX → PC」单向路径；PC→栈 直连 RGMII（回显帧 dst=PC_MAC 不重入栈）
13: //   - 双向帧泵跨 eth_rxc(125M, PHY 晶振) ↔ user_clk(~151.5M, GT 恢复钟)
14: //   - 复位: reset_pb 同步于 init_clk；pma_init 上电脉冲（128 级移位，例程同款）
15: //   - DRP AXI4-Lite 悬空（例程同款，仅需常量输入）
16: // 来源: 官方 39 以太网栈 + aurora 例程共享逻辑（shared_logic/）+ project_7 帧泵
17: //=============================================================================
18: module aurora_udp_bridge (
19:     // ---- RGMII GE1 (PC front-end) ----
20:     input              sys_rst_n ,
21:     input              key       ,
22:     input              eth_rxc   ,

26:     output             eth_tx_ctl,
27:     output      [3:0]  eth_txd   ,
28:     output             eth_rst_n ,
29:     // ---- GT (Aurora 64b/66b, X1Y11 = SFPA) ----
30:     input              gt_refclk_p,
31:     input              gt_refclk_n,
32:     input              init_clk_p ,
33:     input              init_clk_n ,
34:     input              sfp_rx_p   ,
35:     input              sfp_rx_n   ,
36:     output             sfp_tx_p   ,
37:     output             sfp_tx_n   ,
38:     output             sfp_tx_disable,
39:     output             sfp_rs0    ,
40:     output             sfp_rs1    ,
41:     // ---- GT-B (Aurora 64b/66b 第二通道, X1Y9 = 光口Y9 通道B) ----
42:     input              sfpb_rx_p  ,
43:     input              sfpb_rx_n  ,

48:     output             sfpb_rs1   ,

62: //*******************************************************************

132: wire sh_refclk, sh_qpllclk, sh_qpllrefclk, sh_qplllock, sh_qpllrefclklost;

167: //*******************************************************************
168: IBUFDS u_init_clk_ibufds (
169:     .I  (init_clk_p),
170:     .IB (init_clk_n),
171:     .O  (init_clk_i)
172: );
173: BUFG u_init_clk_bufg (

181: //   pma_init : 上电脉冲（128 级移位链，例程同款）
182: //*******************************************************************
183: reg [2:0] rst_sync;
184: always @(posedge init_clk) begin
185:     rst_sync <= {rst_sync[1:0], ~sys_rst_n};
186: end

195: //*******************************************************************
196: // Aurora 64b/66b 共享逻辑支撑（shared_logic/，例程同款）
197: //*******************************************************************
198: aurora_64b66b_0_support_ext u_aurora (   // prj9: _ext 版引出 refclk/QPLL 供 B 共享
199:     // TX AXI4-S
200:     .s_axi_tx_tdata  (tx_tdata ),
201:     .s_axi_tx_tlast  (tx_tlast ),
202:     .s_axi_tx_tkeep  (tx_tkeep ),
203:     .s_axi_tx_tvalid (tx_tvalid),
204:     .s_axi_tx_tready (tx_tready),
205:     // RX AXI4-S

THE DESIGN FLAW IN MY C22 GATING: the release window (single cycle, when s2!=ack) can coincide with a dropping frame → missed forever. The original code had `hs_busy <= 1'b0` unconditioned in busy branch → release always catches its window; then a mid-drop-frame release could let partial bytes in — the corner I was defending against — but blocking the RELEASE entirely is far worse.

content.text:
<path>D:\FPGA\project_9\rtl\frame_fifo_pump.v</path>
<type>file</type>
<content>
1: //=============================================================================
2: // frame_fifo_pump.v — frame-aware CDC pump (self-contained, no IP)
3: // Purpose : cross a GMII frame stream from clock domain A (RGMII PHY eth_rxc)
4: //           to domain B (PCS/PMA userclk2) with FRAME integrity: buffer one
5: //           full frame, then drain it gaplessly into the PCS TX.
6: // Policy  : handshake-gated — frames arriving while the previous frame is in
7: //           flight are DROPPED (wr_drop_cnt). Human-paced UDP/ARP/ping traffic
8: //           has huge gaps; stress mode is future work.
9: // CDC     : Cummings-style async FIFO — gray pointers, 2FF sync both ways.
10: //=============================================================================
11: module frame_fifo_pump(
12:     // write side = source frame stream (domain A)
13:     input               wr_clk      ,
14:     input               wr_rst_n    ,
15:     input       [7:0]   wr_data     ,   // GMII byte stream (preamble..CRC)
16:     input               wr_en       ,   // frame data valid
17:     // read side = PCS/PMA GMII TX (domain B)
18:     input               rd_clk      ,
19:     input               rd_rst_n    ,
20:     output  reg [7:0]   rd_data     ,   // byte out (aligned with rd_en)
21:     output  reg         rd_en       ,   // frame valid out
22:     // status (for ILA / debug)
23:     output  reg [15:0]  wr_frame_cnt,
24:     output  reg [15:0]  wr_drop_cnt ,
25:     output  reg [15:0]  rd_frame_cnt
26: );
27: 
28: //=============================================================================
29: // declarations (all up front — no use-before-declare)
30: //=============================================================================
31: localparam AW = 11;
32: localparam S_IDLE = 1'b0, S_PUMP = 1'b1;
33: 
34: reg [7:0]  ram [0:(1<<AW)-1];
35: 
36: reg  [AW:0] wr_bin;                     // write pointer (binary, domain A)
37: reg  [AW:0] rd_bin;                     // read pointer (binary, domain B)
38: reg  [AW:0] wr_ptr_g, rd_ptr_g;         // gray pointers
39: reg  [AW:0] rd_ptr_g_s1, rd_ptr_g_s2;   // rd gray synced into wr domain
40: reg  [AW:0] wr_ptr_g_s1, wr_ptr_g_s2;   // wr gray synced into rd domain
41: 
42: reg             hs_busy;                // frame in flight (handshake pending)
43: reg             frm_dropping;           // C22: 当前帧按"忙时丢弃"处理(整帧不进 RAM)
44: reg             wr_dv_d;                // wr_en delayed (frame-end detect)
45: reg [15:0]      wr_cnt;                 // bytes written in current frame
46: reg [15:0]      frame_len_mb;           // mailbox: latched frame length
47: reg             wr_done_t;              // toggle: frame available (crossing)
48: reg             rd_done_t;              // toggle: frame consumed (crossing)
49: reg             rd_done_t_s1, rd_done_t_s2; // rd_done sync into wr domain
50: reg             rd_done_t_ack;            // last acked toggle state (wr domain)
51: reg             wr_done_t_s1, wr_done_t_s2; // wr_done sync into rd domain
52: 
53: wire            wr_valid;               // write strobe (data + pointer advance)
54: wire [AW:0]     wr_bin_next;
55: wire            wr_full;
56: wire            wr_en_fall;             // frame end detect (write domain)
57: 
58: reg  [15:0]     rd_cnt_i;               // reads issued
59: reg  [15:0]     rd_cnt_o;               // bytes presented on output
60: reg  [15:0]     rd_len;                 // latched frame length
61: reg             rd_en_i;                // FIFO read strobe
62: reg             st;                     // pump FSM state
63: reg             ram_dout_v;             // ram_dout valid flag
64: reg  [7:0]      ram_dout;
65: 
66: wire [AW:0]     rd_bin_next;
67: wire            rd_empty;
68: 
69: function [AW:0] bin2gray(input [AW:0] b);
70:     bin2gray = (b >> 1) ^ b;
71: endfunction
72: 
73: //=============================================================================
74: // write side: pointers (advance ONLY on actual writes) + frame gather
75: //=============================================================================
76: assign wr_bin_next = wr_bin + 1'b1;
77: // C22 根因修复(2026-09-20): 原式把**二进制** wr_bin_next 与**格雷码** rd_ptr_g_s2
78: // 逐位混比, 在指针回绕(累计字节跨 2048)后永久伪满 → 写侧拒收一切帧
79: // (板上: 25 帧后 ping/UDP 全灭; 仿真: 40 帧只完成 24, 16 帧无声消失)。
80: // 改为标准 Cummings 格雷满判: 写指针下一拍的格雷码 == 读指针格雷码高两位取反。
81: wire [AW:0] wr_ptr_g_nxt = bin2gray(wr_bin_next);
82: assign wr_full = (wr_ptr_g_nxt == {~rd_ptr_g_s2[AW:AW-1], rd_ptr_g_s2[AW-2:0]});
83: // C22: 忙时的帧整帧不进 RAM(帧原子性) —— 否则丢弃帧的字节仍会推走写指针,
84: // 与读侧"恰好读 rd_len 字节"失配, 指针永久错位。frm_dropping 保证释放若发生在
85: // 某丢弃帧中间, 该帧仍完整丢弃而非半截进 RAM。
86: assign wr_valid = wr_en && !wr_full && !hs_busy && !frm_dropping;
87: assign wr_en_fall = ~wr_en & wr_dv_d;
88: 
89: always @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
90:     if(!wr_rst_n) begin
91:         wr_bin <= 0; wr_ptr_g <= 0;
92:         rd_ptr_g_s1 <= 0; rd_ptr_g_s2 <= 0;
93:     end
94:     else begin
95:         rd_ptr_g_s1 <= rd_ptr_g;
96:         rd_ptr_g_s2 <= rd_ptr_g_s1;
97:         if(wr_valid) begin
98:             wr_bin   <= wr_bin_next;
99:             wr_ptr_g <= bin2gray(wr_bin_next);
100:         end
101:     end
102: end
103: 
104: always @(posedge wr_clk) begin
105:     if(wr_valid)
106:         ram[wr_bin[AW-1:0]] <= wr_data;
107: end
108: 
109: // frame gather + 4-phase handshake（含释放逻辑，单块单驱动——C18 根治）
110: always @(posedge wr_clk or negedge wr_rst_n) begin
111:     if(!wr_rst_n) begin
112:         hs_busy <= 1'b0; frm_dropping <= 1'b0; wr_dv_d <= 1'b0; wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
113:         frame_len_mb <= 16'd0; wr_done_t <= 1'b0;
114:         wr_frame_cnt <= 16'd0; wr_drop_cnt <= 16'd0;
115:         rd_done_t_s1 <= 1'b0; rd_done_t_s2 <= 1'b0; rd_done_t_ack <= 1'b0;
116:     end
117:     else begin
118:         wr_dv_d <= wr_en;
119:         rd_done_t_s1  <= rd_done_t;
120:         rd_done_t_s2  <= rd_done_t_s1;
121:         rd_done_t_ack <= rd_done_t_s2;
122:         // C20 修复(2026-09-10): wr_cnt 必须在两个分支都累加。
123:         // 原实现只在 !hs_busy 分支累加，而 hs_busy 拉高的同一拍已把 wr_cnt 清零，
124:         // 于是 busy 期间 wr_en_fall 时 wr_cnt 恒为 0 → 丢帧分支永不成立 →
125:         // wr_drop_cnt 成了死计数器("drop=0" 不能证明没丢帧)。
126:         if(wr_valid)
127:             wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 16'd1;
128:         if(!hs_busy && !frm_dropping) begin
129:             if(wr_en_fall && wr_cnt != 16'd0) begin
130:                 frame_len_mb <= wr_cnt;
131:                 wr_done_t    <= ~wr_done_t;     // frame available -> toggle
132:                 hs_busy      <= 1'b1;
133:                 wr_frame_cnt <= wr_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
134:             end
135:             if(wr_en_fall)
136:                 wr_cnt <= 16'd0;
137:         end
138:         else begin
139:             // handshake pending(或释放落在丢弃帧中间): 整帧丢弃, 计数用 wr_en
140:             // (wr_valid 已被门控, 字节不进 RAM, 只计数供丢弃判定)
141:             if(wr_en && wr_dv_d != wr_en) begin end // (no-op, 保持结构)
142:             if(wr_en)
143:                 wr_cnt <= wr_cnt + 16'd1;
144:             if(wr_en && !wr_dv_d)
145:                 frm_dropping <= 1'b1;
146:             if(wr_en_fall) begin
147:                 if(wr_cnt != 16'd0)
148:                     wr_drop_cnt <= wr_drop_cnt + 16'd1;
149:                 wr_cnt       <= 16'd0;
150:                 frm_dropping <= 1'b0;
151:             end
152:             if(rd_done_t_s2 != rd_done_t_ack && !frm_dropping)
153:                 hs_busy <= 1'b0;                // frame fully drained -> release
154:         end
155:     end
156: end
157: 
158: //=============================================================================
159: // read side: pointers (advance ONLY on actual reads) + pump FSM
160: //=============================================================================
161: assign rd_bin_next = rd_bin + 1'b1;
162: // C21 修复(2026-09-17): rd_empty 必须用当前 rd_bin，不能用 rd_bin_next。
163: //   原式 (bin2gray(rd_bin_next)==wr_ptr_g_s2) 是"提前一拍判空"：当读指针追到
164: //   与写指针持平（rd_bin=末字节地址）时，rd_bin_next 已等于 wr_ptr，于是把
165: //   **每帧最后一字节**误判为空而拒读（板上实测：第二帧恒少 1 字节、rd_frame_cnt
166: //   停在 1、FSM 永久卡死）。本泵是"整帧先写满再读"，读期间写指针稳定，
167: //   用 rd_bin 判空安全：rd_bin 追上 wr_ptr 才为空，末字节允许读出。
168: assign rd_empty = (bin2gray(rd_bin) == wr_ptr_g_s2);
169: 
170: always @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
171:     if(!rd_rst_n) begin
172:         rd_bin <= 0; rd_ptr_g <= 0;
173:         wr_ptr_g_s1 <= 0; wr_ptr_g_s2 <= 0;
174:     end
175:     else begin
176:         wr_ptr_g_s1 <= wr_ptr_g;
177:         wr_ptr_g_s2 <= wr_ptr_g_s1;
178:         if(rd_en_i && !rd_empty) begin
179:             rd_bin   <= rd_bin_next;
180:             rd_ptr_g <= bin2gray(rd_bin_next);
181:         end
182:     end
183: end
184: 
185: // FIFO read data capture (registered, 1-cycle latency, strobed)
186: always @(posedge rd_clk) begin
187:     if(rd_en_i && !rd_empty)
188:         ram_dout <= ram[rd_bin[AW-1:0]];
189: end
190: 
191: always @(posedge rd_clk) begin
192:     ram_dout_v <= rd_en_i && !rd_empty;
193: end
194: 
195: // pump FSM: issue exactly rd_len reads, present exactly rd_len gapless bytes
196: always @(posedge rd_clk or negedge rd_rst_n) begin
197:     if(!rd_rst_n) begin
198:         st <= S_IDLE; rd_cnt_i <= 16'd0; rd_cnt_o <= 16'd0; rd_len <= 16'd0;
199:         rd_en_i <= 1'b0;
200:         rd_data <= 8'd0; rd_en <= 1'b0;
201:         rd_frame_cnt <= 16'd0; rd_done_t <= 1'b0;
202:         wr_done_t_s1 <= 1'b0; wr_done_t_s2 <= 1'b0;
203:         // NOTE: ram_dout/ram_dout_v 故意不在本块复位——由上方无复位捕获块唯一驱动
204:         // （在此赋值 = 双时钟风格多驱动 → MDRV/GND 折叠，坑位 C17）
205:     end
206:     else begin
207:         wr_done_t_s1 <= wr_done_t;
208:         wr_done_t_s2 <= wr_done_t_s1;
209: 
210:         case(st)
211:             S_IDLE: begin
212:                 rd_en <= 1'b0;
213:                 if(wr_done_t_s1 != wr_done_t_s2) begin   // new frame available
214:                     rd_len   <= frame_len_mb;            // mailbox stable (4-phase)
215:                     rd_cnt_i <= 16'd0;
216:                     rd_cnt_o <= 16'd0;
217:                     rd_en_i  <= 1'b1;                    // prime first read
218:                     st       <= S_PUMP;
219:                 end
220:             end
221:             S_PUMP: begin
222:                 // output pipeline: (ram_dout, ram_dout_v) -> (rd_data, rd_en)
223:                 rd_data <= ram_dout;
224:                 rd_en   <= ram_dout_v;
225:                 if(rd_en) begin                          // byte presented this cycle
226:                     rd_cnt_o <= rd_cnt_o + 16'd1;
227:                     if(rd_cnt_o == rd_len - 16'd1) begin // last byte out now
228:                         st           <= S_IDLE;
229:                         rd_en        <= 1'b0;            // stop after this cycle
230:                         rd_frame_cnt <= rd_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
231:                         rd_done_t    <= ~rd_done_t;      // ack -> release wr side
232:                     end
233:                 end
234:                 // read issuing: exactly rd_len strobes
235:                 if(rd_cnt_i < rd_len - 16'd1)
236:                     rd_en_i <= 1'b1;
237:                 else
238:                     rd_en_i <= 1'b0;
239:                 if(rd_en_i)
240:                     rd_cnt_i <= rd_cnt_i + 16'd1;
241:             end
242:         endcase
243:     end
244: end
245: 
246: endmodule

F2 shows: busy released between frames (busy=0), frame 2 completed (wrbin 86→171 = 86 more bytes in). F39: wrbin=1720, rdbin=1720 (empty, drained ✓) — pointers healthy past 1700, no full flag issues.

Check the math: 400ns gap vs ~590ns turnaround → drop every other frame → 20/20 ✓ exactly. The REAL board traffic (python paced, ≥100µs gaps) → no drops. prj8 stress 36/36 passed on internal loopback... with ~100µs python gaps — fine.

But hold on — the BOARD wedge: old code wedged at 25 frames ≈ 2100B (past 2048 wrap). NEW code: F39 at wrbin 1720 no problem... but has the new code passed the 2048 wrap in this sim? 40×86 = 3440 bytes total written > 2048 ✓ passed (F39 wrbin=1720 — hmm 1720 < 2048; total WRITTEN 3440 but wrbin wrapped? 3440 > 2048 → wrbin = 3440 mod 4096... wrbin counts [AW:0]=12 bits → 0..4095 (FIFO 2048 deep uses wrbin[AW] as wrap flag!) — wrbin=1720?? If 3440 written and 1720 read... 3440-1720 = 1720 pending?? NO wait — wrbin as 12-bit counter: after writing 3440 → wrbin=3440 (no 4096 wrap) — F39 shows 1720?! That means only ~1720 bytes written by F39 — 20 completed frames × 86 = 1720 ✓✓ (the other 20 frames were DROPPED — never entered RAM!). Consistent: 20×86=1720 ✓.

So the wrap at 2048 hasn't been crossed in the completed-frame stream yet for the paced TB! For stress TB: 100 completed × 86 = 8600 bytes >> 2048 → wrapped multiple times ✓✓ AND 100 frames accounted, rd=100 ✓. THE FIX IS PROVEN across wraps.

Now — REAL board traffic: python gaps ~100µs >> 590ns turnaround → zero drops expected. The ORIGINAL prj8 M2 criteria (12/12 + 36/36) ran with this pump on internal loopback — meaning with python pacing the pump was never the bottleneck ✓.

Summary of fix validation:
- paced 40: 20 complete + 20 drop (drop = TB pace artifact, policy-consistent)
- stress 200 (10-cycle gaps = 80ns): 100+100, pointers healthy across 2048-wraps (8600B written)
- OLD code same TBs: 24 + 16-vanished (wedge) — regression proven fixed

Rebuild the bitstream now (build9g), reprogram, rerun the full board criteria (ping 20, udp 12, stress 36, then re-ping to prove no wedge).

{"code":"const L = [];
L.push("---",
"type: 调试记录",
"摘要: prj9 真光链路 25 帧后全路径永久楔死——帧泵格雷满判二进制/格雷混比的根因定位与修复全过程",
"created: 2026-09-20",
"---",
"",
"# 调试记录：帧泵 wr_full 伪满楔死（prj9 真光链路）",
"",
"## 一、现象",
"",
"- prj9 双笼 A↔B 位流（回显路径裸 FIFO 版与 unpack→pack 版**行为完全相同**）：",
"  - ping 20/20 全过（<1ms）",
"  - udp_verify：L=26 ✓ L=27 ✓ **L=28 起全部超时**",
"  - 之后 ping 也 0/3、0/5——**整条回显路径永久楔死**（重烧恢复，必现）",
"- T23 常亮（channel_up_a & channel_up_b 均为 1），hard/soft_err = 0",
"",
"## 二、定位过程（判别实验链）",
"",
"1. **换 B 回显架构无效**（裸 FWFT FIFO → unpack→pack 整帧存储转发，楔死点分毫不差）",
"   → 排除 B 侧回显实现，确认为确定性楔死（第 26 帧）。",
"2. **ILA 两阶段尸检**（ila_cap_wedge.tcl / ila_cap_wedge3.tcl）：",
"   - ILA0（user_clk）：pk_frames=up_frames=prev_wr=**25/25/25** 完美平衡，pk_ovf=0，ch_up=1",
"     → **光纤回显路径无辜**（A.TX 发多少、A.RX 收多少、泵B 进多少，全对账）。",
"   - ILA1（eth_rxc）阶段1：5 次 ping 期间 stack_txen **零触发**——栈没产生任何回复帧。",
"   - ILA1 阶段3：抓到干净 ARP 请求（PC 在重解析）+ **stack_txen=72 拍**（栈在发 ARP 回复），",
"     但 pfwd_wr 停在 25、pfwd_drop=0。",
"3. **三难排除法**：帧到达（dv=1）∧ 栈在发（txen=72 拍）∧ 泵零写入零丢弃零完成",
"   → 唯一自洽解：**wr_valid 被 wr_full 永久挡死**（wr_cnt 恒 0 → 既不完成也不丢弃，与全部证据吻合）。",
"4. **读码发现公式错误**（frame_fifo_pump.v 原第 95-96 行）：",
"   ```verilog",
"   assign wr_full = (wr_bin_next[AW] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW]) &&   // 二进制",
"                    (wr_bin_next[AW-1] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW-1]); // 格雷码——混比！",
"   ```",
"   累计字节跨 2048（2^11，FIFO 深度回绕）后该式伪真且读侧空闲时永不解除。",
"",
"## 三、仿真复现（证据闭环）",
"",
"| 测试台 | 旧代码 | 修复后 |",
"|---|---|---|",
"| 40 帧慢节奏（86B×40≈3440B，跨回绕） | 24 完成 + **16 无声消失** | 20+20 全对账（丢弃为 TB 节奏快于泵周转，合规） |",
"| 200 帧紧节奏（写指针累计 8600B 跨回绕 4 次） | — | 100+100 全对账 |",
"",
"修复期二次踩坑（C22b）：帧原子性门控初版把 hs_busy 释放与 frm_dropping 耦合，",
"释放窗口（单拍）恰逢丢弃帧中途被永久错过（仿真 40 帧只完成 1）——改为释放不受",
"frm_dropping 门控，半帧防护由 frm_dropping 独立保证。",
"",
"## 四、修复（git f7c8be8）",
"",
"1. **满判改标准 Cummings 格雷满**：`wr_full = (bin2gray(wr_bin_next) == {~rd_ptr_g_s2[AW:AW-1], rd_ptr_g_s2[AW-2:0]})`",
"2. **帧原子性**：忙时到达的帧整帧不进 RAM（frm_dropping 粘滞到帧尾），丢弃帧字节不再推走写指针",
"3. **复位对称化**：泵A 写侧、泵B 读侧复位统一为 ~aurora_rst（原不对称会在链路抖动时单侧复位→指针失配）",
"4. （同 commit）B 回显由裸 FIFO 改为 unpack→pack 级联——与 prj8 第一根因同解",
"",
"## 五、板上判据（2026-09-20，全部通过）",
"",
"```
PROGRAM_OK → ping 20/20 (<1ms) → udp_verify 12/12 → 压力 36/36 → 复测 ping 10/10（无楔死）",

# 调试记录：帧泵 wr_full 伪满楔死（prj9 真光链路）

## 一、现象

- prj9 双笼 A↔B 位流（回显路径裸 FIFO 版与 unpack→pack 版**行为完全相同**）：
  - ping 20/20 全过（<1ms）
  - udp_verify：L=26 ✓ L=27 ✓ **L=28 起全部超时**
  - 之后 ping 也 0/3、0/5——**整条回显路径永久楔死**（重烧恢复，必现）
- T23 常亮（channel_up_a & channel_up_b 均为 1），hard/soft_err = 0

## 二、定位过程（判别实验链）

1. **换 B 回显架构无效**（裸 FWFT FIFO → unpack→pack 整帧存储转发，楔死点分毫不差）→ 排除 B 侧实现，确认为确定性楔死（第 26 帧）。
2. **ILA 两阶段尸检**（ila_cap_wedge.tcl / ila_cap_wedge3.tcl）：
   - ILA0（user_clk）：pk_frames=up_frames=prev_wr=**25/25/25** 完美平衡，pk_ovf=0，ch_up=1 → **光纤回显路径无辜**。
   - ILA1（eth_rxc）阶段1：5 次 ping 期间 stack_txen **零触发**——栈没产生任何回复帧。
   - ILA1 阶段3：抓到干净 ARP 请求 + **stack_txen=72 拍**（栈在发 ARP 回复），但 pfwd_wr 停在 25、pfwd_drop=0。
3. **三难排除法**：帧到达 ∧ 栈在发 ∧ 泵零写入零丢弃零完成 → 唯一自洽解：**wr_valid 被 wr_full 永久挡死**（wr_cnt 恒 0 → 既不完成也不丢弃，与全部证据吻合）。
4. **读码发现公式错误**（frame_fifo_pump.v）：
   assign wr_full = (wr_bin_next[AW] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW]) && (wr_bin_next[AW-1] != rd_ptr_g_s2[AW-1]);
   —— 二进制 wr_bin_next 与格雷码 rd_ptr_g_s2 逐位混比；累计字节跨 2048（FIFO 深度回绕）后伪真，读侧空闲时永不解除。

## 三、仿真复现（证据闭环）

| 测试台 | 旧代码 | 修复后 |
|---|---|---|
| 40 帧慢节奏（86B×40，跨回绕） | 24 完成 + **16 无声消失** | 20+20 全对账（丢弃为 TB 节奏快于泵周转，合规） |
| 200 帧紧节奏（写指针累计 8600B 跨回绕 4 次） | — | 100+100 全对账 |

修复期二次踩坑（C22b）：帧原子性门控初版把 hs_busy 释放与 frm_dropping 耦合，释放窗口（单拍）恰逢丢弃帧中途被永久错过（仿真 40 帧只完成 1）——改为释放不受 frm_dropping 门控，半帧防护由 frm_dropping 独立保证。

## 四、修复（git f7c8be8）

1. **满判改标准 Cummings 格雷满**：wr_full = (bin2gray(wr_bin_next) == 拼接(~rd_ptr_g_s2 高两位, rd_ptr_g_s2 低位))
2. **帧原子性**：忙时到达的帧整帧不进 RAM（frm_dropping 粘滞到帧尾），丢弃帧字节不再推走写指针
3. **复位对称化**：泵A 写侧、泵B 读侧复位统一为 ~aurora_rst（原不对称会在链路抖动时单侧复位→指针失配）
4. （同 commit）B 回显由裸 FIFO 改为 unpack→pack 级联——与 prj8 第一根因同解

## 五、板上判据（2026-09-20，全部通过）

PROGRAM_OK → ping 20/20 (<1ms) → udp_verify 12/12 → 压力 36/36 → 复测 ping 10/10（无楔死）

WNS=+1.006ns。**prj9 真光链路连通性与数据级判据达成**：数据渡光两次（A.TX→纤→B 回显→纤→A.RX）。

## 六、方法论沉淀

- “计数器全对账 + 零触发”是定位楔死类问题的黄金组合：先证无辜段，再逼出唯一自洽解。
- 板上必现的 bug 必能在仿真复现——复现前不动手修（本轮又验证一次）。
- 修并发逻辑时警惕“顺手加固”引入的新耦合（C22b 教训：防护与释放解耦）。

1. **CDC 只有三种合法形式**：帧泵式格雷指针异步 FIFO、2FF 同步器（打拍≥2）、4 相握手邮箱。新跨域路径必须三选一。
2. **mark_debug 探针标注时钟域**，ILAs 挂同名域——跨域采样探针曾是 WNS=-2.6ns 的元凶（prj8 首轮实证）。
   B 通道（user_clk_b 域）探针绝不能挂 A 域（user_clk）ILA。
3. **互不相关时钟必须声明时钟组**：`set_clock_groups -asynchronous`（eth_rxc / gt_refclk 派生 / init_clk 三组），否则跨域路径被假同步分析重罚。
4. **XDC 只用受限 Tcl**：不能 `if/foreach/puts`（实测整段丢弃，CRITICAL WARNING [Designutils 20-1307]）。参数化约束改在 Tcl 脚本里生成。
5. **判据无旁路原则**：数据通路必须被链路状态硬门控（`aurora_rst=~sys_rst_n|~channel_up`）——链路没起来板子对外静默，判据通过 ⇔ 数据真的穿过了链路。
6. **一个 quad 只允许一个 GT_COMMON**：多 Aurora 同 quad 时，第一个实例的 support 引出 refclk+QPLL 四件套（`_ext`），兄弟实例用无 common 的 `_shared` 版；各实例私有 MMCM 时钟模块与复位逻辑。
7. **Aurora 核端口方向**：`gt_pll_lock` 是核的**状态输出口**（外部 assign 驱动它 = MDRV-1）；外部锁定状态只走 `gt_qplllock_quad1_in`。
8. IP 参数不确定时**只设置有把握的**——set_property 遇到不存在的参数名是致命错（fifo_generator 实坑）。

## 六、调试方法论（按代价升序）

1. **判别实验**：换已知好的位流（官方例程）对照，先分「硬件 vs 实现」。
2. **ILA 单会话三段式**：同一 Vivado batch 会话内 arm → 起流量（ping）→ upload → CSV。arming 易失，**不能跨会话**。触发探针名要与 probes.ltx 一致；`TRIGGER_POSITION` 属性不被接受（省略或 catch）。
3. **网表解剖**：`open_checkpoint` 两份 dcp 对比元件/位置/绑定（prj8 定位 BUFIO 被吸收即此法）。
4. **延迟扫描**：时序边缘问题时改一个参数出一流（IDELAY 500→1250ps 即收敛过程），每次记录 ping 通过率。
5. 每轮调试落**调试记录**（现象→假设→实验→证据→结论五要素），入 vault `操作文档/调试记录_*.md`。

# FPGA_Project — 毕设 FPGA 工程（工程索引）

多 Agent 协同推理的 FPGA 交换节点：Kintex UltraScale **XCKU060** 实现**标准以太网 + 高速光互连**数据交换（缓存/直通双模式转发），参考 MoA 架构（ICLR 2025）。

**架构定位（2026-09-04 定版）**：端点/上位机通信 = **标准以太网（千兆）**；Aurora 64b/66b = **板间干线**（单板阶段用于数据级验证，接入多块板组交换网络时作为板间 10G 互联）。

> **给 Agent/协作者**：工程规范（事实源优先级、硬件事实卡、CDC/ILA/XDC 规范、调试方法论、坑账本）见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。

## 里程碑

- ✅ **M1（2026-08-11）**：Vitis 导入硬件平台，Hello World 串口打印成功（COM7@9600）
- ✅ **IBERT 物理层（2026-08-27）**：10G PRBS 跨口跳线过纤，PLL Locked + 0E0（眼图已归档）
- ✅ **Aurora 64b/66b 链路层（2026-08-31）**：内部环回，channel_up/lane_up/误码全 0（ILA）
- ✅ **以太网上位机通道（2026-09-04）**：UDP/ARP/ICMP 栈 + 抓包验证（ping / 回环 / 四包链）
- ✅ **M2 数据级桥（2026-09-18）**：PC UDP 数据穿越 Aurora 64b/66b 编解码往返——ping 10/10+20/20 全 <1ms、udp_verify 12/12 + 压力 36/36 逐字节一致；三根因（unpack 断流 / 帧泵 rd_empty off-by-one / RGMII RX 采样相位）全部修复闭环
- 🔄 **当前推进：真光链路（project_9）**——去内环（loopback 3'b000）+ 双笼 A↔B 版位流已产出（WNS=+1.008ns），待接线验证
- ⏳ 后续：IBERT 眼图（空闲通道 C/Y10、D/Y8）→ 双板干线 → DDR/DMA 解冻 → 双模式转发 → 性能测量

## 当前推进（2026-09-20）

- ✅ **prj9 双笼真光链路判据全过（09-20，git f7c8be8）**：A(Y11)↔B(Y9) 双 10G 模块 + LC 跳线，数据渡光两次。判据：T23 常亮 + ping 20/20 + udp_verify 12/12 + 压力 36/36 + 复测 ping 10/10（无楔死），WNS=+1.006ns。
- 🔍 本轮根因：帧泵 wr_full 二进制/格雷混比，累计字节跨 2048 回绕后永久伪满（25 帧后全路径楔死）。仿真复现+修复验证（`project_9/sim/`），详见知识库《调试记录_prj9_帧泵格雷满判_2026-09-20》。
- ⏭️ 下一步：IBERT 眼图观测（同 quad 空闲通道 C/D，或换装位流）→ 双板干线 → DDR/DMA 解冻

Sessions are probably stored somewhere like ~/.dsh or AppData. I need to find the session log files. They could be large (this session has lots of content). Let me search.

What's the stack's max UDP payload? The official stack likely supports up to ~1472B. Need to check udp module's capability — the official 39 example's udp_tx... The RX side parses by length field; TX side echoes. Our bridge is TRANSPARENT (echo everything). The stack's UDP module: udp_rx parses arbitrary length frames up to its buffer; the echo path: udp_tx re-sends the payload. Constraints: MTU! PC NIC won't send >1472 payload without fragmentation; fragment reassembly NOT in the stack. So chunk size ≤1472. Test with several sizes: 512, 1024, 1400.
   - Evaluation metrics: 
     - completeness: total bytes sent vs received, chunk count
     - integrity: SHA256 of reassembled stream vs original file
     - loss: chunk sequence numbers, gaps
     - reorder: seq numbers monotonic
     - corruption: per-chunk MD5 mismatch (without dropping the whole file verdict)
     - throughput: bytes/sec, effective Mbps
     - latency: per-chunk RTT stats (min/avg/max/p99)
     - wedge check: post-test ping
   
3. **Known limitation — pump single-frame-in-flight**: the frame pump processes ONE frame at a time (~590ns turnaround at full rate... wait no: the pump's turnaround = read drain time (frame_bytes × rd_clk period + handshake) ≈ for 1472B frame: 1472×6.2ns ≈ 9µs. PC-side python can't send faster than ~50-100µs between frames anyway (socket + GIL), so no drops expected. But the pump has no buffering for back-to-back bursts — if we blast without pacing, drops WILL occur (by design). So the test should:
   - default: paced (small inter-frame gap ~1ms or adaptive)
   - also measure the drop boundary: burst rate test (send back-to-back, count echo) to find where drops start — that's the "capacity characterization" part.
   
   IMPORTANT: this is a REAL limitation for the future multi-agent use: burst traffic will drop frames with the current single-frame pump. This stress test will QUANTIFY it — great input for the future redesign (multi-frame FIFO).

4. **PC-side script**: `json_storm.py` (or udp_file_xfer.py):
   - Args: file path, chunk size, delay, count
   - Read file → chunk → send with seq number + total chunks header? But that changes payload... Better: send RAW chunks (file bytes as-is) and reconstruct by order received (UDP echo preserves order through our bridge? The bridge is in-order per-frame (single pump serializes). Reorder could happen in PC network stack? Loopback through the NIC — generally ordered. For rigor: prepend a tiny header (8B seq + 4B length) per chunk = structured framing, still "full data" (the framing is the test protocol; original file recoverable = SHA match proves integrity).
   - Receiver: same socket, collect echoes with timeout, match MD5 per chunk, reorder via seq, reassemble, SHA256 compare, stats.

5. **Find session JSON**: Let me look for DSH session storage. Likely C:\Users\15266\.dsh\sessions or AppData. Search for recent .jsonl files.

6. Also the stack's UDP RX: does it accept arbitrary ports? udp_verify uses port 1234 (board MAC/IP fixed). The board echoes ANY UDP to its IP? The udp module replies to the source port with same payload (echo). Our bridge: transparent. Fine.

7. Max chunk: also NIC MTU and the stack's RX FIFO — official 39 udp module had max packet length limits? udp_rx: rec_byte_num counter 16-bit; it handles jumbo? MTU 1500 keeps us safe. But ALSO: our pump RAM is 2048B per frame — frame = 14+20+8+payload+4 FCS = 46+payload ≤ 2048 → payload ≤ 2002. MTU limit 1472 binds first. OK.

8. Session JSON size: this session could be MBs. Sending MBs at ~1ms/chunk × 1472B = 1.4MB/s → a 5MB session = ~3.5s. Fine. But bigger: if session is 50MB, still ~35s. OK.

Need zstd decompression on Windows without extra tools... Python 3.14 has `compression.zstd` module in stdlib (3.14 added zstd support)! The system python is 3.14 → `from compression import zstd` (PEP 784, python 3.14). 

Test design (json_storm.py):
- Input: any file (JSONL), chunk size (default 1400B payload for framing 12B + file 1388... actually let's frame: [4B magic][4B seq][4B chunk_len][4B total_chunks]? Keep header small: 8B: seq(4)+len(2)+flags(2). Payload chunk = raw file slice. UDP payload = 8B header + slice. Chunk slice default 1360 → UDP 1368, frame 1368+42=1410 < 1500 MTU ✓.
- Receiver thread: collect echoes, per-chunk: MD5 compare, seq tracking, RTT (send timestamp embedded? RTT measured at echo arrival - send time; embed monotonic send time? simpler: measure arrival delta locally — send loop paced, receiver matches seq → RTT = now - t_send[seq]).
- Interleave: sender paced with configurable gap (default 1ms). 
- End: send DONE marker? Just finish after all sent + drain timeout 2s.
- Output stats: sent, received, lost list, corrupted list, reordered count, RTT min/avg/max/p95, Mbps goodput, SHA256 original vs reassembled.
- Burst mode: gap=0 → measures pump drop behavior (documenting capacity boundary).

Extra rigor: the echo path is transparent — receiver should verify payload EXACTLY (header+slice echo identical).

Board constraints: frame pump single-frame-in-flight: paced 1ms gap = fine. Burst: drops expected — that's a FEATURE of the test (capacity characterization), not failure — report separately.

Also: PC-side socket recv buffer — set SO_RCVBUF large (4MB) to avoid local drops at receiver.

Also file reassembly: write received to output file, sha256 compare vs original file.

Steps:
1. Copy + decompress session zstd → D:\FPGA\project_9\sim? No — test data dir: D:\FPGA\project_9\testdata\session_full.jsonl (ASCII path ✓ per AGENTS rule).
2. Write json_storm.py.
3. Calibration: first 200KB slice, chunk 1360, gap 1ms.
4. Full file run.
5. Burst probe: 500 frames gap 0.
6. Post-test ping (wedge check).
7. Archive: script to git, results to vault doc.

{"code":"const NL = String.fromCharCode(10);
const cmd = [
"$dst = 'D:\\FPGA\\project_9\\testdata'",
"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dst -Force | Out-Null",
"Copy-Item \"$env:USERPROFILE\\.dsh\\sessions\\--C-Users-15266-Desktop-~6BD5~8BBE--\\session-32bc5420-4fbc-4839-982e-62f11a24cad1\\session.v3.jsonl.zstd\" \"$dst\\session_snap.zstd\" -Force",
"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'",
"& 'C:\\Users\\15266\\AppData\\Local\\Python\\pythoncore-3.14-64\\python.exe' -c \"from compression import zstd; import pathlib; raw = zstd.decompress(pathlib.Path(r'D:\\FPGA\\project_9\\testdata\\session_snap.zstd').read_bytes()); pathlib.Path(r'D:\\FPGA\\project_9\\testdata\\session_full.jsonl').write_bytes(raw); print('decompressed bytes:', len(raw))\"",
"$f = Get-Item \"$dst\\session_full.jsonl\"",
"Write-Host ('文件: ' + $f.Length + 'B  改于 ' + $f.LastWriteTime.ToString('HH:mm:ss'))",
"$h = Get-FileHash \"$dst\\session_full.jsonl\" -Algorithm SHA256",
"Write-Host ('源 SHA256: ' + $h.Hash)",
"Write-Host ('JSON 行数: ' + (Get-Content \"$dst\\session_full.jsonl\" | Measure-Object -Line).Lines)"
].join(NL);
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: cmd, description: "Snapshot and decompress session JSONL"}
